review_title: Views of Kauai That You Can't See From the Ground
review_text: Air Ventures was very professional from start to finish. Our pilot gave us a wonderful tour and pointed out waterfalls and other beautiful sights. Motion sickness was a problem for some in our party, even though they had taken Dramamine, so know ahead of time that this can happen. But the views are spectacular, and we all felt very safe.

review_title: Surprise birthday present for my husband - seaplane tour of SF!
review_text: What an amazing way to experience SF! A whole new perspective. We absolutely loved our ride! Thank you!

Booking was easy and straightforward.  Communications were excellent.  Staff was ready early.  Pilot was courteous, professional, and provided a safe and comfortable ride.  Pilot was entertaining and engaging for both our older passengers and 11 year old child.  Fantastic family experience.

Aircraft appeared well-maintained.  Also, very roomy, even for two adult males in the backseat at 6'2" & 6'4".

I will happily book again with Envi Adventures in the future.

Outside of Envi's control, but adding to the experience: very calm air, beautiful day, incredible Cascade mountain scenery.

Best pilot  great plane ride .....saw some wild life...the staff  young lady from new jeresy was very helpful.
when we return we will fly the Talkeetna range again!

Pilot was fabulous, kudos to Kevin. Our photos were spectacular with this once in a lifetime experience. The weather was perfect for viewing all of the awesome sights. Definitely the highlight of our Alaskan journey.

We had a wonderful time.  The pilot and helper were very nice.
The pilot explained what we were seeing and because it was such a nice day he showed us a few areas that are not usually seen due to clouds.
We enjoyed the view and would definately do it again

It was my first trip to Kauai and this was certainly one of the many highlights of my trip. 

I found Wings Over Kauai on this site, and after my experience, I think they deserve all the positive accolades. 

My whole experience with Wings Over Kauai was positive. 

Booking - I procrastinated, and didn't book the tour until the day before. I was sitting at the Honolulu airport waiting for my connecting flight to Kauai. I sent in a request, and by the time I landed in Kauai, Maren has already confirmed my reservation for the next day. 

Pre-flying + Flying - I didn't get to meet Ellen, but Maren and Bruce are super nice and very friendly. They are great guides, very knowledgeable. They definitely want to make sure you have a memorable experience, not just with the tour itself, but also with your trip to Kauai. You are not flying with too many people (I think they said 4 people max). Everyone gets a seat with a good view! The tour was one of the first things I did on my trip, and because I didn't do much preparation, the tour definitely helped orient me and helped me plan out the places I should check out.

Post-flying - It was great to receive a personal follow-up email (not a standardized one) from Maren with photos. 

Cost - I didn't do much price comparison, but it was definitely on the lower side. 

Everyone who is going to Kauai should definitely set aside time to take a helicopter/plane tour, and I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. :-)

Awesome misty fjords experience up close with experienced and wonderful crew. We were able to even spot multiple whales, landed in an awesome scenic place. One caution though is don't fly right after a meal, as some of us didn't do well with that. Overall we were welcomed and entertained very well.

With a young family we found our options for aerial tours was limited as most helicopter tours would not take a child under 2 years.  While we didn't take our young child on the tour in the end, the search for a aerial tour led us to Wings over Kauai. (incidently, they did indicate they could take a child under 2 yrs)  We took the private flight in the smaller plane and enjoyed the flight and knowledgeable  commentary of our pilot.  The only negative of the flight if you are a photo buff  was maybe the plane is not ideal if you wanted high quality photos through the  windows which are not ideal for photography.. but we dont see the world enough with our own eyes these days anyway! Good excuse to just enjoy the view and company instead of looking through a digital screen which we all tend to be guilty of more and more these days.
The views were BREATHTAKING. Eric made the experience so much more wonderful. I can’t recommend this enough!

We did not get the experience we booked. The cloud cover and fog prevented us from seeing Denali and landing on the glacier. Those were the top 2 things we booked the trip for. BUT...they did take us up on a shorter trip that was still amazing AND refunded the difference promptly. I believe they did the best they could do considering circumstances beyond their control.  What more can you ask for? I recommend this company 100%. They are organized, care about the experience and the safety of their guests. The operation was well run and worth the cost.

Amazing time out in the bi-plane. Pilot was funny and knew the island well. I would recommend this to anyone. I am not a fan of heights and I even had a great time. Well worth the time and money. Pilot even did a few tight turns and fun moves in the air with us.
Eric, thank you so much! Loved the 5 island tour and seeing the Molakai sea cliffs! Enjoyed the historical tour also. Fantastic service. Recommended!

Wow, you just can't describe the aerial views of the majestic grand canyon in words or really one photograph either. Westwind did an absolute marvelous job with our flight from start to finish. Kyle, our pilot, did a great job of safely ensuring our flight was enjoyable and educational. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience and definitely recommend using Westwind if you want a once-in-a-lifetime experience of a canyon overflight. You cannot achieve this magnificent perspective from the ground. Awesome!
This was a good experience the driver was knowledgeable and the flight was great. Boat trip was ok. Overall good time

Wife had never seen Grand Canyon so I took her there for surprise 50th anniversary present.  No better way to see the canyon than by chopper which she had never been on.  The flight was amazing.  Everyone at Maverick was friendly and helpful.  Dave, our pilot,was knowledgeable about the canyon and had a great sense of humor.  I think he had as much fun as we did.  It was the highlight of our day!
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: Could not have been better. Well worth it.
review_text:
Could not have been more professional.  The plane, an otter, accommodated about 9 people and was in immaculate condition.  The pilot was highly experienced and was an excellent guide.  The view of the mountains was breathtaking and landing on the Ruth Glasier was surreal.  Although the trip was pricey, you could justify it within the context of maintenance, care, and higher fuel costs.
Well worth it.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: My wife and I went on a tour to Multnomah Falls and loved it. Great job to the pilot. Airplane looked great, pilot did great, and the views were great. Couldn't ask for anything better. Really fun company.

This place is clean and professionally run.  The plane was nearly new and very nice.  The headphones worked well and the pilot was very experienced; I felt very comfortable flying with him.  Not sure why we needed to get there 45 minutes early, but it wasn't really a problem; I just hate getting up early.  Unfortunately Denali's peak was hiding in clouds, but we got to see base camp which was busy that day.

review_title: Awesome flight Hawaii - Maui Plane Rides
review_text:
Eric is a brilliant pilot, he maneuvers the plane with great care, super friendly and you can feel his enormous experience.
The flight was simply fantastic! Wonderful views of Maui and Moloka'i from above. Unforgettable, the highest sea cliffs in the world, Moloka'i North Shore Hawaii. I can really recommend a flight with Maui Plane Rides, a must do on Maui!

We had an awesome flight with Leanne - such a smooth flight and take off and landing and our trip around Denali was simply breathtaking! No bad seats on Leanne’s plane as she ensured everyone had a good view from all seats. So glad we did this and Mother Nature gave us an awe inspiring and simply amazing display! I booked this trip thinking it wouldn’t be much but how wrong I was!! Thank you Leanne, your flying and narration were fantastic! Mum and I had the best time!!!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: WOW! What an amazing flight! My husband and I booked the "Ultimate Miami & Beaches Tour" for our staycation honeymoon, and had the most incredible experience. Adriel warmly greeted us upon arrival, and let us watch and ask questions as he prepped the plane. Captain Tony is beyond awesome, and gave us the most magical tour of our hometown city. The view was spectacular - words can't do it justice. We had the privilege of seeing tons of manatee warming up in the canals during our Miami "winter" and even took our kayak out the next day to visit some of the beautiful spots that we could never had discovered without that glorious bird's-eye view provided by Captain Tony. A million thanks to Seaplane Tour of Miami for gifting us with the most amazing honeymoon excursion a couple could ask for. We can't wait to take another trip with this wonderful father/son duo!

review_title: Denali air tour with glacier landing.
review_text: We flew with TAT, with pilot Chris at the controls of their ski equipped de Havilland Otter, on a tour of the Alaskan Range, Denali area.  While clouds prevented us from seeing Denali herself, Chris still was able to land us on Ruth Glacier for about a 20 minute visit to the glacier, in front of the famous Sheldon Chalet.  This was one of the best travel adventures my family has ever been on.  The scenery was incomparable, Chris' knowledge of the terrain and history were superb, and landing on a glacier in late July in a mild snow storm was a once in a lifetime experience.  If you are in Alaska and looking for something different  to do, make the trek out to Talkeetna--a very cool Alaskan village in itself, and fly with TAT.  Many thanks to Sandy (Go Vols!) and all to working us in last minute due to the weather and making this happen for us.

My husband and I opted for the Southside explorer trip with glacier landing. All I can say is that the term 'awesome' was probably coined for such an experience. Special call out for Melissa our pilot and Emily who is a part of the ground staff. Do not miss this one!
The best experience ever. The ride smooth and the view were awesome. I got to fly the plane and enjoy.
Trip was great with the custom plan and commentary. The guide was knowledgeable and we felt safe during the trip. The views were wonderful

We looked at helicopter tours of the island and they were very pricey and short.  This tour was much longer and much less expensive.  You also have the comfort of a plane which is not going to be going up and down as rapidly as a helicopter.
Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and had cold compress towels for us because it's a longer plane ride and there isn't a lot of air conditioning.  
We went all over the island and we all had microphones and headsets and could all communicate with the pilot.
This is a very safe and enjoyable ride and you won't regret it.

We did the Grand Denali, with a glacier landing, and we loved every minute! It was an incredible experience that we will never forget. Talkeetna Air Taxi did a great job. Check in was smooth. They provided glacier boots to cover your shoes and sunglasses if you didn't have any. Our pilot made sure everyone had a great view on approach to the glacier and gave us enough time, once we had landed, to take photos and enjoy the mountain views. 
      I felt safe on this trip and never felt rushed. This was a once in a lifetime experience for us and one we will never forget. We had a beautiful clear day on the day of our flight, so we were very fortunate. I highly recommend this trip as a most memorable excursion.

The pilots are excellent, friendly, knowledgeable, and skilled. 

But, don’t get your weight estimate wrong or Keith at the front desk will talk down to you as if you lied on purpose. I have family in aviation, so I understand the importance of weight distribution on an aircraft. But, when my wife’s weight came in above the number I had sent in, Keith had little to no sensitivity about it. 

So, in the end my wife and I were not able to be on the same helicopter. I was upset about that, but I understand. They want to keep us safe, and flying in high heat can be dangerous. But, what I don’t appreciate is the way Keith handled the situation. Repeating statements like “This number is WAY over the estimate given to us.” is nothing short of an emotional punch in the face to anyone who has ever struggled with weight issues. 

So, in the end, the stars I give are for the pilots. They are truly the 5 star champs of this company. But, my experience with Keith’s lack of sensitivity at the front desk quite literally ruined the experience for both of us. So, I would recommend that management coordinate some much needed sensitivity training for Keith. It would be a great improvement for your customer service.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text:
Kauai is our favorite island. There’s just something different about it. It has a different feel, a different vibe. Maybe it’s the chickens everywhere, or the cattle or the more mature landscape. Just not sure. From the air, it’s gorgeous. We flew Wings Over Kauai. Very, very nice people. We were very lucky in that the other people on our flight cancelled, so we had the entire Caravan to ourselves. Bruce, the owner, was our pilot. We took off on 30, NW, turned right and circled the island clockwise. Got great pictures during a flyover of the Crown at dock. The day was partly cloudy with clouds and rain over the center of the island. The water was pure aqua blue, the coastline just picture perfect rocks and white spray and the green of the trees contrasting with the red of the soil could not be done justice in a photo. We cut inland up Wameia Canyon, saw the Jurassic Park waterfall, flew inland of the Pacific Missile Test Range main base, but cut back out over the ocean just before we go to the northern most telemetry radars sitting on top of one giant cliff. 

Flew along the Napoli Coast. Saw the trail wind its way through the cliffs, on top of huge sea caves and along knife edge ridges of rock. Broke back over the northern coast over the resorts and golf courses and the locations they filmed Jurassic World. Cut around the NW part of the island, flew a circle around the Fantasy Island waterfall, saw the cattle grazing in almost chartreuse meadows, flew back over the ship and landed back on runway 30. The whole trip was about 70 minutes, at a ground speed of around 90mph. Judy filmed the whole thing with the action cam, and I took about 160+ stills. We also ordered a video of the flight. They had GoPro’s on each wing. 

This was one of the best value excursions we’ve ever had in Hawaii. Judy did get a little queasy coming around the hills to the NW of the airport. The air was a bit bumpy, but not bad at all. Nothing like the helicopter we took in Juneau in 2001.
The flight was fantastic. We say views we could not see any else. I would highly recommend the trip. And in the end we had a great landing.

After a busy morning exploring the Na Pali coast by small boat we decided seeing it by air would be great too.  Air Ventures Hawaii came to our rescue and we truly had a flight to remember.  The views were beautiful nothing was too much for Ray (our pilot) to show us and his stories about the island were wonderful.  It topped off a wonderful day all round but the truly most amazing thing was that by the time we left we felt as if we had made friends for life with Ray his beautiful wife and the staff.   An exceptional company I can give no greater compliment than thank you for making us feel so welcome.   Please please Air Venture Hawaii is a must.

Bruce and Ellen were amazing!  This really was one of the highlights of an incredible trip!  I was a little nervous as I am prone to motion sickness, but Bruce gave me some pointers, Ellen sent us off with ginger chews and Bruce kept it smooth sailing!  I sat up in the co-pilot seat and it was truly one of the most memorable hours of my life!  The views of the island are spectacular, Bruce was so knowledgeable and friendly.  A nice touch - before we got on the plane Bruce took a picture of us in front of the plane - by the time we landed, Ellen has printed it out and used it as the cover for a 5-10 mins DVD of the plane ride set to music!  Most other places would try and charge you more for this but it was our gift and it is truly appreciated!  I don't know what else to say except don't leave Kauai without doing this!!!

This was an absolutely fantastic experience and I would highly recommend it! The pilot was so nice, accommodating and did anything and everything possible to ensure we were comfortable and had a great experience. Thank you Maui Plane Rides for making our anniversary so special and memorable!

Our pilot was excellent! He provided all kinds of information and views of Denali on a overcast-not so clear day, and we saw everything and more than we had hoped for! We got up close and personal to many peaks, glacier fields, and flows. What a thrill to see the peak from several directions, none of which could be seen from the base or viewing areas. Well worth every cent!

We had perfect weather for our flight with Leanne! She was as delighted with the experience as the passengers because the day was perfect for viewing all Denali has to offer. Having seen the landscape in 3D suddenly all those hours spent in my Geography class made sense. Anyone who travels to Talkeetna should take this flight. It's simply marvellous!!!!
We had a great flight. Our pilot, Eric , did a great job of showing the beautiful scenery. I would highly recommend this trip, if you really want to see the real Hawaii.
My girlfriend gifted me a tour of Mt Hood for my birthday as a surprise. The two of us went up and the pilot was more than happy to talk aviation with a civilian enthusiast like me.

Writing this review on behalf of my parents. We sent them there for 40 year anniversary this past Spring. I researched scenic flights for hours and this company shined through all the rest. Reviews were spectacular and the price was much cheaper than helicopter rides. My dad gets motion sickness but had no trouble at all on this private chartered flight. The owner actually took them around the island and he was extremely informative and polite. My parents had a blast. When I called from the mainland, they were so accommodating and helpful. They did not have any other clients flying on the day that we wanted but did a flight just for my parents. Don't cheat yourself out of this very special treat, it's once in a lifetime folks! Book it and you won't think twice or regret for one second!

Tremendous  flight on a prefect day!!  This is the second time in several years that we have done this flight seeing trip with TAT since we live in Alaska.  This time with our grandsons who enjoyed the trip especially landing on the glacier where they enjoyed make snowballs.  This is definitely a must do for a trip to Alaska.  The scenery and the views from the plane were exceptional, many glaciers close up and shear mountain peaks.  Some of the planes are a little tricky to get in an out of with my bad knee but it worked.  We had a group of 7 and we filled the whole plane.   The TAT staff and pilots are all very friendly and helpful. They do provide boots to where for the snow on the glacier. A camera with a zoom lens is a must but you don't have room for camera bags or backpacks on the planes.
  I think flying from Talkeetna is the best option, it is the closet to Denali Mt.  If you are short on time you could fly with an other companies from Anchorage but cost is higher and time near Denali would be limited.  Since weather is always a factor I always try to schedule my flight seeing on the way up to Denali park in case weather cancels the flight then maybe I can reschedule on the way back

We had booked a grand tour with glacier landing a few months before we travelled. Unfortunately when we arrived in Talkeetna for our flight the weather was not the best. However we were very impressed with K2 Aviation, they explained the situation to us and we were given a choice of taking a different trip as no glacier landings were possible. We decided to fly as we preferred to see something then not go at all. We were refunded the difference between our tours without even asking and our refund was waiting for us when we returned from our flight. We were asked to wait until it was clear to fly. Our pilot was Chuck and he did a fabulous job, we were so glad we waited and went on the 2 hour flight, the snow capped mountains and glaciers were amazing, we even got a glimpse of Mt. Mckinley. This company is very professional and obviously concerned for the safety of their passengers. They do their best to provide you with the best flight possible to suit the weather conditions.
Incredible experience. Breathtaking views. A Miami bucket list activity got sure. Super friendly guide/pilot made it that much more memorable

My husband and I booked this tour separately while on the cruise ship "Pride of America."  Ellen responded quickly to each email.  We were met at the ABC store right outside the pier and driven at no additional cost to the airport.  This particular day four of us flew with Josh in the larger plane.  Two additional people flew with Bruce in the smaller plane.  The larger plane could have accomodated all of us.  However, Ellen and the staff wanted everyone to have the best possible seats to view everything.  Josh did an awesome job narrating everything we saw.  It really helped that we had driven the coast the day before in a rental car, so we had a better idea of what we were seeing.  In addition, Josh made a couple of extra passes, so we were able to get a closer shot with our cameras.  I was amazed at how smooth the flight was, particularly the take-off and landing.  When we landed, we were ready to pay and do it again.  When we returned to the cruise ship, we met several other people who flew with Wings Over Kauai.  Everyone agreed this was the best tour we could have possibly done.  We always try to book privately and not through the cruiseline.  It helps the independent small business owner.  This company goes above and beyond when it comes to customer service.  We will definitely do this tour again when we return to Kauai.  If you cruise on Norwegian's Pride of America, rent a car the first day in port and drive the island. (We started driving at 8:30 a.m. and returned the car at 8:00 p.m. and saw the entire island.) Fly with Wings Over Kauai on the second day, since day two is a shorter length of time.  Thanks Ellen, Bruce, and Josh for making this adventure the best anyone could hope for.

We arrived today at Wings Over Kauai Air to be greeted by Mary, nice young lady.   She told us everything we needed to know about the in's and out's of the Trip ... then she ask for payment. How unusal in this day and time, my husband made these reservations weeks ago and Wings didn't even ask for partial much less full payment.  
While we are meeting Josh our Pilot Mary is outside cleaning our headset, windows to see better and putting drinks in the plane for us. 
We get on board and Josh takes off. Excellent commentary on everything we were seeing. Josh was well spoken,  We would ask questions and He would have the answer.  Josh had excellent knowledge of this beautiful island that we flew over.  Beautiful weather, great flight, Thank you Guys!

review_title: Wonderful experience-Denali flight seeing along with glacier landing
review_text:
Excellent knowledge of our pilot about the mountains and glaciers.
It was spectacular sight flying above the glaciers.The tour was worth the money.

review_title: There is no better way to see the canyon!
review_text: OK, well, maybe a better way is to hike down to the bottom, or use a hang glider.  But for most of us, this is THE best way to go.  We rode in a 9-passenger plane for nearly an hour, at about 8,000 feed.  Everybody had a large window, and the canyon still completely filled the view.  The audio commentary wasn't much to listen to, just a bit of trivia and history.  But the flight was well worth the ticket price...and it was far less than you'll pay for any other airline ticket!  We will definitely do this again if we ever make it back to the Grand Canyon.

We booked this tour through our cruise ship at the last minute and we re all so glad we did.  We were nervous about being on a small plane, but the pilot was reassuring and we did something we will probably never get a chance to do again.  Thrilling!  It was worth the money.

Eric’s “Maui Plane Rides” fulfilled a bucket wish list, once in a lifetime trip. Eric was professional, courteous and a wonderful guide.  We saw Maui’s  beautiful north shore and the West Maui mountains, the dramatic cliffs of Molokai,  the shoreline of Lanai, circled Molokini and Haleakala,  then on to the  majestic waterfalls near Hana....my brief description of our trip just doesn’t do it justice, it was awesome.  We felt that making our trip memorable was Eric’s number one praiority. 
Eric, thank  you for amazing day that we will always remember

We had a wonderful flight over Denali National Park and to the glacier.  Our weather was perfect, few clouds and no fog.  We landed on the glacier and 2 members of our flight had a wedding ceremony officiated by our pilot.  I highly recommend this excursion!  I was in awe of the beautiful mountains, glacier, and the sights of Talkeetna and the rivers from the plane.

review_title: Flight to Denali and Glazier Landing.
review_text: The flight was wonderful.  It was a beautiful clear day.  The pilot showed up several points of interest.  The Glazier Landing was very smooth.  I would recommend to friends.

Our pilot, Kevin, flew the smoothest flight of my life.  I’ve been a frequent flier on commercial and private jets for 20 years and this was the best flight I’ve ever been on.

The scenery was breathtaking and the glacier landing was amazing.

I was so nervous about this flight....but I had no reason to be.  Completely safe and under control the entire time.

My 3 year old loved it!  She won’t stop talking about it...

What a great experience for the whole family.

Don’t miss this.
Incredible trip, organization, pilot, and memories.  Highly recommend K2.  Did the grand Denali tour and the trip was a big success.

This truly was the highlight of our time in the Grand Canyon. No we can confidently say "We have seen the Grand Canyon"! Worth every dollar! 

We had originally booked for Wednesday afternoon, but the trip was cancelled due to heavy winds. This made us feel very safe, as we were slightly concerned in the morning.. Our tour was rescheduled for the next morning. Great service
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: This is one of the top 3 tourist activities I have ever done.  The entire flight and landing was so memorable.  The pilot was engaging.  The sites were incredible.  Landing on a glacier next to Denali was unforgettable.  Even Ernie, who was our driver from our hotel, was amazing.  This is a MUST DO while in Talkeetna;  spare no expense, it is worth every penny.

review_title: Wonderfully friendly, personable, and two great flights!
review_text: We have done both the Misty Fjords and the Bear Viewing trips.  I highly recommend SeaWind Aviation! Leslie is wonderfully friendly, and the pilots are terrific.  Our bear guide was patient, kind, knowledgeable, and friendly.  We thoroughly enjoyed both our trips, the scenery is beautiful.  We were lucky enough to see several bears. Highly recommend this for a cruise excursion, or for a fun vacation activity!

review_title: Best part of our Kauai trip.
review_text:
Never did this before and been wanting to do this so other people's reviews led us to choose Wings Over Kauai over the helicopter tours. 

From the time Ellen acknowledged our reservation and Abi welcomed us at the counter and Capt Bruce flew us, it was just one warm and pleasant experience. It turned out to be the most exhilarating part of our trip to Kauai. No wonder it ranks #1 here. You must do it too.
Well managed and friendly staff.  Pilot Timmy was very educational and provide a smooth flight and landings   Fantastic experience for the family that ranged from 18 to 75 years old.

Our air tour of Kauai was great.  As the advertising says, you can't really appreciate the island until you see it from the air.  Our pilot and tour guide was knowledgeable and an outstanding pilot.  I highly recommend Air Ventures

Wings over kauai was the perfect way to end our vacation on the island. The views were amazing, our pilot Bruce gave us lots of interesting facts about the places we flew over. We saw the whole island pretty much, he took us over the places you can't get to by car. The staff really make it about the quality of your experience. I recommend it to everyone if your in kauai!

This adventure was the absolute highlight of our trip to Alaska. Although it is an expensive flight tour, it is worth every penny you will spend. We were fortunate enough to have a fairly calm and clear day, and the views of Denali and the mountains were outstanding. We were able to land on the glacier, and the views from the glacier were magnificent, and an experience I will never forget. If he is available, ask for Captain Stan. He was an incredible host who shared very interesting narration throughout the trip.

Wear warm winter clothes and comfortable boots or shoes, and K2 will provide special boots for walking on the glacier. The company is also really great about screening for COVID-19, and our negative test results were required in order to take the flight tour. Masks were also required when in the K2 buildings and throughout the flight.

review_title: Great glacier landing and view of Mt McKinley and surroundings
review_text: K-2 Aviation and their staff and pilots really love their jobs which makes our travels all that much better. For me the highlight of our 8 passenger single engine flight was the upclose view of the snow covered mountains and landing on a 13,000ft high glacier. A view of 20,237ft Mt McKinley up close was the best because frankly, we had the best clear skies you could want. Loved it. Recommend highly...

All I can say is WOW. This was truly a once in a lifetime experience. Our pilot, Carla, was so knowledgeable and amazing. I can’t recommend this tour enough and I felt like my money was well spent. We even got to see wild bison! If you only have one day to see the Canyon then this is a great value.
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_text: This sight seeing flight was truly amazing.  We circled the entire island, overflew the “Grand Canyon of the Pacific” and saw several incredible waterfalls, all with exceptional narration from our wonderful pilot, Kevin.  A not to miss experience when you are on Kauai.  It will be the highlight of your visit!

A gift for my 68th b-day. What a treat. My husband is an experienced fixed wing airplane pilot so our flight with the owner/pilot, Bruce, was designed to view Kauai from above AND to share with a fellow pilot, the joys of such an experience. Bruce and his Cessna 172 were more than up to the task. It was a very informative opportunity to learn about Kauai wonders with a career islander who loves what he does. The staff was very professional and the flight a highlight of our time on Kauai.
Personal and perfect plane ride! Customized to what we wanted. Highly recommend!! Excellent experience. Highlight of our trip. We will be back to take another flight.

We were initially a bit disappointed when the helicopter tours were booked out and opted for a fixed-wing Highlights tour instead. Good move! We saw much more of the canyon when we did a helicopter tour a few years ago, and loved every minute of it. The staff - both on the phone, at the counter and the aircrew - are fantastic. Without exception, they are courteous, friendly and very helpful.  I would have no hesitation whatsoever in recommending this tour - well done Scenic!!
Great time. Pilot was friendly knowledgeable  greatest his job. Flight was comfortable. Office staff was spot on with the pilot.  Highly recommended.

Everything was great. Totally recommend this tour if you’re looking for a cheaper option compared to the helicopter tour. Saw so many amazing things, the Na poli coast is breathtaking. Pilot was calm and very informative.
The views were amazing and our pilot Nick did an excellent job giving us the highlights and adding his personal touch since he grew up in Kauai.

review_title: A wonderful way to see Kauai
review_text: My wife and I went on AIr ventures the 2nd day of our cruise time in Kauai. We had wanted to do a helicopter ride, but the price of air ventures made the decision for us. It was a great way to see beautiful Kauai. The pilot was very knowledgeable. The flight was a little bumpy but well worth it. It gave you a look at a lot of the area that you can't get to by car. We loved this trip and would recommend it to anyone.

This was the first stop on my Alaskan vacation and it was by far the most memorable.  A Talkeetna Air driver picked me up in this picturesque town (think Northern Exposure) and dropped me off at the airport a mile away.  There I was greeted by a friendly representative who cautioned that the questionable weather could impact the views of Denali and the possibility of a glacier landing. Having donned the headphones hanging on the strap, Leann explained what we were seeing and the gave us an unforgettable tour. review_title: Incredible Way to See the Whole Kauai
review_text:
We love this air charter tour company and have taken their tours several times while on Kauai. Most of Kauai is not viewable because of the terrain, so seeing the island by air is a must at least once while on the island. Wings Over Kauai offers a comfortable air tour of the entire island with spectacular views of the most popular and breathtaking sites the island has to offer, including: waterfalls, coastlines, Waimea Canyon, the inner island, sugar plantations, resort areas, and open sea.

On our last trip, we were thrilled to see several pods of whales swimming in the open sea from the air. Incredible! Throughout the ride, you'll hear about the island (including some history) from the friendly pilot through noise-cancelling headphones. The plane is small, carrying only about 8 passengers and they are always on time with their flights. Be aware that harsh weather will sometimes interrupt the tours, so it's a good idea to call ahead if the weather looks ominous. The flight leaves from the Lihue airport - very easy to find their hanger, just past the main terminal. 

The plane tours offer a much more affordable way to see the island, as opposed to the helicopter ventures. Wings Over Kauai also gifts you with a lovely DVD as a thank you gift for taking their flight. My spouse and I will be watching our videos (both theirs and those that we took in flight) many times to remember this special trip. Highly recommended.

review_title: Best experience of our Alaskan cruise!
review_text: This was the highlight of our Alaska cruise! The pictures can't even do it justice. Steven, the pilot, shared lots of great info and took us over the most amazing sights. When we passed over a whale, he circled once so everyone could see it. Same thing when he spotted a black bear eating dandelions! Leanne, the shuttle driver, was sweet as can be. And their dog was so friendly and adorable. If you can only afford one shore excursion during your cruise, do this one!!!

The Denali flightseeing adventure was oustanding. Beautiful day, 10 passenger plane, smooth flight, great pilot and the most unbelievable views of the mountain and glaciers. In 40 + years of traveling I think this was the most outstanding excursion I have ever experienced. Some of our travel group was ambivalent about the flight but everybody came away from the experience in awe. You have to do this.
We had a wonderful air tour of Kauai and would highly recommend! Makoa was an excellent pilot and guide.
Best part of our family Alaskan cruise.  The views were astounding!  Our pilot, Rick , was very experienced and informative. The staff was great. An amazing adventure.
Our pilot was very nice and did a great flight, around San Francisco, Sausalito , golden Gate Bridge and Alkatraz…. Thank you so much

review_title: Memorable experience and the best air tour for family with kids
review_text: I strongly recommend Wings over Kauai, it was a 65 min tour and the pilot ( I forget his name), was so friendly and gave us a thorough commentary of all the spots we saw. The plane ride itself was smooth. Me ( pregnant) with our 3 yr old son and my husband enjoyed it very much. Our son was a champ, he saw the mountains for a while and then fell asleep. The ride was not bumpy or nauseating for me. The headsets keep the noise off the engines... it was quite windy and it was nice that they had blankets. The airplane was small enough to hold 6 of us comfortably. We saw waterfalls, beautiful waimea canyon, sacred pool, Napali coast and the entire island covered with rocky and sandy beaches. This is a must do event, if you are planning to relax and not do anything else. We also recieved complimentary kukui shells lei and a very nice family photo infront of their plane. Thank you WOK for a memorable experience.

review_title: Taquan Air Great Tour but don't appreciate the dishonesty
review_text:
When we arrived in Ketchikan on Tuesday, June 23, 2015, it was a beautiful day so we decided to book a seaplane excursion of the Misty Fjords.  We ended up at Taquan Air and everyone was friendly and they showed us a safety video and told us that Taquan Air had a 100% safety rating.  This eased my nerves. Due to the company overbooking, our group of 7 people had to go on the Cessna Caravan, a very nice plane, a little bigger than the DeHavilland Beaver (my husband was disappointed we didn't fly the Beaver but loved the Caravan), and our pilot, Kevin, was wonderful and gave us an amazing tour of the Misty Fjords and landed on a beautiful lake where we were able to get out on the pontoons.  This excursion was a highlight of our trip to Alaska until two days later when we heard about the tragic crash of a seaplane doing the exact same excursion where all 9 people on board perished.  I reassured myself that Taquan Air had a better safety record than ProMech Air, until I came across the below article.

The article made me feel betrayed by Taquan Air, and stupid for not doing more of my own research. The Cruise Lines and the tour companies seem to be too driven by profits that they may not cancel flights when necessary due to bad weather and are enticed into telling customers lies about their safety records so people won't back out of excursions.  I still would've taken the flight had Taquan told me about the 2007 incident, but now I'll never fly with them again.

I'm giving a rating of 3 (wish it could be 2 1/2) because the Pilot, Kevin, was amazing and he seemed like an excellent pilot and made everyone feel very comfortable and deserves 5 stars, but the companies dishonestly about the crash in 2007 deserves ZERO stars.

Alaska News
As Southeast Alaska plane crash victims' life stories emerge, so do echoes of 2007 accident
Nathaniel Herz
June 27, 2015
He cited the 2007 crash that also happened during a tour of Misty Fjords, which an NTSB report a year later blamed on pilot error and inadequate supervision of the Southeast Alaska tour industry by the Federal Aviation Administration. Subsequent recommendations by the NTSB included the installation of webcams in the area and special weather training for tour pilots. 

2007 Misty Fjords crash

Weather in Ketchikan the day of the crash was unsettled, with scattered showers and wind gusts hitting 26 mph.

“Equally impressive are the flight challenges posed by such dramatic terrain and volatile weather conditions,” the filing said.

In the 2007 crash, Ketchikan’s Taquan Air Service had sent three planes on Misty Fjords flight tours.

All three planes were flying through a shallow mountain pass known as “the cut.” The first plane made it through and the third plane’s pilot turned around and took a different route after running into what he described as a “wall of weather” — rain, fog and low clouds — according to news reports.

The second plane, a de Havilland Beaver, crashed in a box canyon and slid 250 feet down an embankment. All five people aboard were killed.

The pilot, 56-year-old Joseph Campbell, had 25 years of commercial aviation experience, but only seven hours of flying experience in Alaska when he was hired by Taquan to fly that summer.

This was an experience of a lifetime.  We chose the summit tour with glacier landing. This tour brought us up close and personal with Mt. Denali, as well as many of the other peaks of the Alaskan range. Our pilot, Clay, was knowledgeable and funny, while making us comfortable on our first small plane flight.  We took hundreds of photos on the flight and glacier landing.  The glacier landing was a highlight of the trip. Words aren't sufficient to describe this trip.

My wife and I were looking for a way to see all of Kauai without the leg work of hiking a network of trails.  Air Ventures offered us exactly what we wanted and tossed in an added bonus as Paul, our pilot, happened to see a couple of humpback whales shortly after our take-off from Lihue.  He circled the whales giving folks on both sides of the plane a chance to see the wonder of nature.  The trip gave us the opportunity to see the Napali coast, Waimea canyon and all the untouched parts that make up the island of Kauai without having to deal with blisters, muddy clothing and sore muscles.  Thanks Air Ventures for the view of a lifetime; we'll be back to see you again on our next visit!

Amazing sights. Did helicopter tour and went to all the spots. Amazing. Ask for Chris Wiley as he is the best and most informed helicopter and plane pilot. Problem was that with the ticket you get free lunch and get to choose off an entire menu. But when you order you are only allowed a hotdog or nachos... Not the entire menu even though it's printed on the wall.

review_title: Great tour, beautiful views, best value
review_text: My sister-in-law is visiting Kauai for a week, and it is her first time here.  Although we are taking her to many of the beaches and beautiful spots on Kauai; to put it all in perspective, I thought about taking her on a helicopter ride.  It had been a few years since I last toured Kauai by helicopter and had not realized how much more expensive, they now are then I remember.  My wife found online Wings Over Kauai Air Tour, and suggested I research.  I reviewed how much they cost for how much time in the air, and I think Wings Over Kauai is half the cost of a comparable helicopter air tour.   So, we booked an afternoon tour in their Air Van.  Huge windows, comfortable seats, and so much quieter than the helicopter tour my wife and I had earlier this year over the Big Island.  I got to sit in the co-pilot seat, my wife and sister-in law were in the row directly behind the pilot and me; there was a 4th passenger directly behind my wife.  Turns out the 4th passenger works for the Hawaii State Parks on Kauai, and he was treating himself to seeing some of what he can never see from the ground.  We lucked out with the weather, and had perfect visibility, and saw so much of the beauty of Kauai, many canyons and waterfalls that can only be seen by air.  The pilot was great, he was also very informative.  Our check-in process was flawless, and I was surprised that there were no upcharges for everyone getting a great view (seat) and perfect opportunities to take lots of pictures.  It was a super blast to sit in the co-pilot’s seat, I just had to remember that I had front and left windows to look through in addition to the large right window at my side.  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai as a top activity to book while visiting Kauai and for residents too; you will love this.
Super friendly and informative staff. Our favorite excursion. Great ride and beautiful scenic views. Was really impressed with, Doug, our pilot. Informative and experienced!

45min impressionnante!!

review_text: We were orignally supposed to do a tour on Christmas Eve. Bruce came back from the flight before ours and said that the Napali Coast was covered by clouds.  He gave us the option to reschedule which we did for a flight a few days later.  The rescheduled flight was super! The weather was excellent and the commentary about the island was excellent. WE got some great photos!  It is a BEAUTIFUL island and Bruce & Ellen are really nice people.  You felt like you were with friends you had known for years. I highly recommend there flight!

I have never flown in such a small plane, especially one that takes off from the water. This was such a cool experience and gave such a different view of the islands! The pilot was also super knowledgeable in pointing out specifics of the islands and giving the history of the island as well! This is something I will always remember and would definitely do again, if we revisit the islands!
This was certainly the highlight of our trip to Alaska. The guide was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. We enjoyed every single minute!

Hermoso paseo para conocer la inmensidad del cañón, se aprecia una vista totalmente diferente que desde la pasarela.
Todo funciono perfecto, desde la reserva online, envió de voucher y salida en horario. El tour tiene audio en distintos idiomas que comentan datos del cañón.
Muy recomendable!

Was the helicopter ride expensive? More than two nights' hotel accommodation (Best Western, Tusayan) and meals! But for an unparalleled perspective of the canyon, including the surprise of your life when your get to the canyon, you can't buy the experience anywhere else. The round trip from lift off to touch down was about 55 min, and the route (because of FAA rules) traverses parts of the canyon one normally sees. Go late in the day, when the later afternoon sun helps reveal the rocks' colors and shadows accentuate the topography. Expect a wait, even if you have reservations: flights are filled in order booked, but these have to be mitigated by passenger weights so the load is safe and balanced. In our case, we arrived after some others but because our weights (we're lighter than the average North American) were within the range they needed to fill up a load (typically 6 passengers), we kind of jumped the queue (to the vocal displeasure of one couple). Other than that, you'll get a supremely capable pilot who has a broad knowledge of local nature and geology. Don't look upon the cost as a luxury - look upon it as adding a third dimension to your otherwise level perspective.

review_title: Don't miss this tour with K-2!
review_text: K-2 is the way to go!  Very professional from the very start to end.  Our pilot in the Otter was knowledgeable with the geology and knew every canyon and glacier by name AND could multitask as a pilot, tour guide and flight attendant all at once!  At the very end of the flight Denali peak came out of the clouds and he made one more turn so that we could all see it- amazing! Jill and Ray took great care of our family.  We appreciate your professionalism and fun environment.  We appreciated them taking pictures with our own phones and emailed us one too that they took.  Thank you again!

review_title: An amazing flight to the summit
review_text: My daughter and I enjoyed the spectacular flight to Denali and landed at Base Camp. There aren’t enough adjectives to describe or photograph accurate enough to depict the grandeur or majesty that we witnessed. The trip of a lifetime!!

We had an awesome flight around in a helicopter for an arches area tour. Michael was an awesome tour guide, he talked about all the areas of interest along our flight. Got to see a few of the awesome arches around Moab.  Thank You Michael for a great flight for our Anniversary!

TJ took us up.  It was my first time in a small plane and was in the co-pilot seat.  Could see everything.  Just a bit bumpy now and then, never an issue.  We saw all the major and some minor sights on the island.  It was thrilling.  Over too soon, TJ brought us back safely.  Hope he achieves his dream of commercial flying.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is Hands Down a Better Deal than the Helicopter Tours
review_text: My husband and I were considering a helicopter tour when we overheard a couple rave about the Cessna plane trip they took over Kauai.  Turns out, they went on Wings Over Kauai and loved it.  We immediately booked it and were impressed by the friendliness of Bruce and his assistant.  Not only did we feel like we were appreciated as customers, we got an excellent tour of the island.  The views were spectacular (as expected) and it was a very comfortable ride.  The cabin was quiet and the headsets were exceptional--you could easily speak with the pilot and the passengers.  I loved the pictures they took of us, and the little extras that made this the best value on the island.  My only disappointment is that for all the places that I looked for activities (magazines, brochures, etc.), that Wings Over Kauai was not mentioned.  The editors of the magazines are missing a great asset to Kauai.  I for one, will be spreading the name of Wings Over Kauai!

Experienced, knowledgeable and funny.  He is a Trip Advisors STAR!(I told him this as I was researching this trip).  Absolutely mind blowing and breathing views of the Grand Canyon. Thank you to Maverick and Forrest for an experience we will never forget!

review_text: This adventure was a surprise for my wife on our 3rd wedding anniversary.  Visibility wasn't great along the coast so we did a loop over the north bay, then back to the  the ball park coming back by the golden gate and over Alcatraz.  Pilot/owner had a great local knowledge of the history and development of the area.  Wish we had one more lap to pick his brains and get another perspective on an area we both grew up in and thought we knew so well.  We chased the flight with an amazing dinner right down the street on the waterfront people watching.  Couldn't have been a better evening.

This was my first experience with Steve and Lesley and SeaWind Aviation.  The Fjords were beautiful.  Steve explained the area and the history.  We landed on an mountain lake and taxi up to an island.  It was exciting to land and take off from such a remote area.  Steve pointed out the waterfalls as we ascended into the sky.  It is amazing to me that a plane can be that close to the scenery and still be safe.  We also looked for brown bears and saw many species of birds. Coming into the rocky picturesque landing of Ketchikan was breath taking! What a wonderful way to view the Fjords.  Thank you SeaWind!
Staff was professional and helpful. Car seats for infants were provided, and the pilot was knowledgeable and friendly.

review_title: Sea Plan from San Juan to Seattle
review_text: My husband and I decided instead of taking the ferry to and from the islands, we wanted a different mode of transportation returning to Seattle. We took the sea plan from Friday Harbor to Seattle (Renton), and it was great! Our pilot was friendly, knowledgeable of the land and history, and told us facts and stories as we flew over different areas. It was a unique way to see the area, and we are very glad we did it. The trip was approximately 45 minutes; it was smooth taking off and landing and felt very safe. We loved it!

We did the Summit Tour with a glacier landing at the beginning of the month. It was just amazing! I was not sure about the oxygen mask when we booked but there is nothing to worry about. The views of the Alaskan Range are crazy and the glacier landing is an unforgettable experience.

review_title: First time on a seaplane - great experience!
review_text: From start to finish this was a very professional experience.  The seaplane was a time saver for getting from Seattle area to Friday Harbor - less than an hour.  I was happy that headphones were provided as the plane was noisy but to be expected.  Both the take off and landing were not scary at all and a very soft landing at Friday Harbor.  I would highly recommend this experience.

We arrived on the island early Monday morning and by Tuesday afternoon we had driven up the Waimea Canyon road, out to Princeville and along the coast.  Wednesday morning we arrived for our biplane air tour.  It was great, showing us more of the island than we could ever see by car.  It is better in the open cockpit biplane because you can smell the wonderful aroma of the tropics. Harry our pilot was fantastic and informative.  This is a must do for island visitors.  Remember its open cockpit so keep in mind the weather. The ceiling on this little plane is 14,000 ft. the highest point on the island is 5100 ft.  So we were above the highest peak and turning circles in the canyon flying through the low hanging clouds.  This 300 hp biplane is unique in itself. A real stick & rudder plane.  Having driven around the island prior we could make out land marks of where we had been and where we would like to go and explore further.  Make an effort to visit Air venture tours.  Its worth your time. Thanks Harry

review_title: Great Experience and It is worth it!!
review_text: I took the tour with Glacier Landing. I was a great experience. I was co-pilot on the way back!! The overall experience and service is excellent. The staffs very friendly. The airplane is clean and well maintained. Highly recommended.

Larry flew us- outstanding service , piloting and memorable trip- thank you for safety , knowledge, the music ,education but mostly a fantastic life experience in one of nature’s awesome gift to all of us.

We managed to pick a beautiful sunny afternoon for our Greater Bay Area tour which included a very convenient pick up and drop back at Fisherman's Wharf.  There were five adults and one child and we were seated comfortably inside the DHC2 Beaver aircraft with headsets to listen to Aaron's expert commentary. Awesome! Eduardo is the best, the tour is beautiful. Had a very safe and enjoyable time filming with you.
Amazing views,fun experience would definitely recommend to friends and family would try again but for a longer experience

This island has so much to see but a land tour would not do it justice as time would be against you paricularly if you are from a cruise.This air tour wraps at least three/four ships tours into one with views that land access would not allow.
Pick up can be agreed, when booking, at the shopping area having been dropped off by the ships free shuttle service. review_title: Flight around Denali and landing on glacier was AWESOME!
review_text: Leah our pilot did a fantastic job.  The flight to and around Denali was one of the best things we have ever done on a vacation.  The landing on the glacier and ability to get out and walk around such an incredible place was spectacular.  It was EXPENSIVE, but I have to say, well worth the money.

review_title: Best Birthday Present I Ever Gave Someone
review_text:
This was hands down one of the most awesome & memorable "adventures" I have taken my dad on. He absolutely loved it, as did I. We purchased a package that lasted an hour, which I think it a perfect amount of time. 30 minutes wouldn't have been enough, and 2 hours + would have been too much (maybe?). The pilot was super knowledgeable about the city & it's history, as well as current projects taking place around the area. Smooth flight, plane was in great shape. My only suggestion is to make sure all the outlets & jacks you plug the head sets into are working properly, as the sound was a little spotty at times for both me & my dad. 

Overall, excellent investment & well worth it.

Feb 02, 2011.  We had our flight booked through Expedia from our hotel.  Being a pilot myself, my wife and I were looking for a fun flight around the island where I could do the actual flying under the guidance of  a local pilot.  Wings over Kauai provided just that.
We were greeted by very friendly and professional people who checked us in and flight briefed us.  Bruce, our CFI did all the radio work and navigation while I was able to do the flying. He is also a great tour guide as he pointed out places of interest and gave a brief history of the site.  I highly recommend Wings of Kauai to any pilot who wants to log some time and have an interesting tour over the island.
MAHALO to Ellen and Bruce.

review_title: What a view of the canyon!!
review_text: We took a helicopter flight over the GC in Aug 2014 and loved it.  Our pilot was knowledgable but didn't talk the whole time which let us enjoy the scenery.  We could communicate on the headsets with microphones but once we got over the canyon it was mostly quiet in awe of the view.  We chose the longer tour as you can see a lot more of the canyon and it may be the only time we visit.  After the flight the pilot offered to take our photo by the aircraft which was a nice surprise--most places would use their own photographer and charge an arm and a leg.  I definitely recommend this tour!
This aerial tour was such a great time - JP was our pilot and we had a blast with him. Mt. Hood was covered by clouds but the alternate route was still awesome and we took fantastic pics. 10/10!!

review_title: Great Flight and Bears on Pricne of Wales Island
review_text: My wife and I had booked a tour with one of SeaWind Aviation's competitors who had to cancel at the last minute. However, they did not leave us out in the cold.  They contacted SeaWind who scheduled us at the last minute and gave us a great tour.  Leslie made sure we were ready and comfortable when the plane arrived and the flights were some of the smoothest I have ever had. There were a total of five of us on the 8 passenger deHaviland Beaver.  We were met on the island by our guide named Diamond.  He is a long time Ketchikan resident (since the 30s) who was delightful.  His knowledge of the area is amazing.  We were able to see several black bears fishing including a mother and her twin cubs.  My last photo at the stream is of two bears fishing with  bald eagle sitting in a tree overhead.  Both on the way to the island and back we saw whales below us.  Each time the pilot circled so we could watch and take photos.Doesn't get much better than that!  Highly recommend this company.
Pilot had a flight to do and was not very interested in us as a costumer. Look out the window and have a great time. I would recommend the Helicopter ride next door. A much better experience.
Such a wonderful time!   Beautiful scenery great pilot full of neat information!   Highly highly recommend this trip!

review_title: Wings over Kauai – a flight to remember
review_text:
My husband and I recently returned from a much needed vacation in Kauai. We planned a couple of events to do… and Wings over Kauai was one of them. I was too afraid to do any of the open door helicopter tours, and thought that Wings over Kauai sounded like a good option for me.  I am so thrilled with our experience. Bruce (the pilot) and Ellen (his wife) were so kind and professional. From the time we called them and spoke to Ellen, to getting into the plane with Bruce, we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I was a bit scared getting into a small plane (flying over the ocean) but Bruce was so experienced and professional and calm, he really made me (and my hubby) feel at ease.

There is no other way to truly see the beauty that Kauai offers. If you are scared to fly, do not worry. I get sea sick easily and am terrified of heights (and I mean terrified…), and thoroughly enjoyed this trip. Also, a few people we met in Kauai told us that they had horrendous experiences with some of the helicopter companies. I am so glad we chose to go with Wings over Kauai. The price is right too. Thank you Bruce and Ellen!!!
Enjoyed every minute of the tour. Our pilot Paul was very nice and narrated very well. Definately should be on the "must do" list. Awesome experience! Beautiful sight!

review_title: Best Way to See All of Kauai in 70 minutes
review_text:
After visiting Kauai on & off since '92.  I'd done most of the attractions, including a helicopter ride on the first visit. This time we chose Air Ventures because my sister's knee injury prevented her from doing much walking. The flight was the perfect way to see the island come alive in a comfortable, safe way. I highly recommend it.
Patricia Heer

It was a great flight.
The only disappointment was that the instructions on how to use the headset during the flight were hard to understand, so we couldn't talk to each other. We could hear the pilot's instructions, which was perfect. I would recommend this flight.

review_text: This was by far the best and most organized tour! A must do if visiting the Grand Canyon. First you fly over the canyon for spectacular views. Flight was smooth. Then jeep down to Antelope canyon with our Navajo guide giving us all the best photo tricks.  Thanks Rosie!  After that they drove us down to Glen Canyon dam where we boarded pontoon rafts for a very smooth and breathtaking trip on the Colorado River.  I can't express how great this tour was. Everything was perfect and can't imagine my vacation without it. Made it the best tour ever for me.

We went on a day flight and the weather was fantastic. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable on the mountain range and answered all the questions we had. We took the 1.5 hour flight without the glacier landing and it was worth every penny. We could see Mt. McKinley from top to bottom and all the glaciers well. Words can't explain the awesomeness of this flight. My smile never left my face. It was also my first flight on a non commercial plane and I felt safe the whole time. If we go back I think we will do the glacier landing.
My teen daughters and I had a wonderful flight!  We will remember the experience for years to come.  Wonderful people to do business with!

review_title: Flight around and onto Denali, Mt McKinnley
review_text: We chartered flight with K2 to see Mt Denali and landed on a glacier.  We had a very experience pilot who did a great jog getting us there and back safely with a lot insight into the area.

Can't say enough about Wings Over Kauai.  From the minute you arrive you are treated so nicely - a fresh flower and kukui nut necklace and then a personalized tour from Bruce.  The views are spectacular; just doing the hike up Waimea won't allow you to see anything like this.  Words can't describe what you will see - you have to take this tour.

I booked the Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna.

Unfortunately the weather was not perfect, the tour was cancelled, but another tour was offered - Southside Explorer. We took it. It was excellent. We saw a lot of glacier. I can only imagine that Grand could offer a lot more...

I agree that it is better safe than sorry but I feel I still need to delete one star from that.  If they offer me a FREE hat, that would be a different story.

The office staffs and pilots are all very professional. A plus.

When scheduling air tours in Alaska, you really have to give yourself some slack. You cannot control the ever changing weather. But that only works in theory. Summer season is so busy in Alaska. Tours are all booked up in advance. Your next opening is probably next year 8-(
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: What a great experience.  Josh took us on an amazing adventure.  He is so knowledgeable regarding the island and made the whole time very entertaining and fun.  What gorgeous views!! We didn't want it to end.  Great meeting Dori and hearing about Mili's (their dog) story.  Very professional and awesome tour group.  Would highly recommend it!

Breathtaking experience!!! We do 100% recommend! 
The tour was amazing and the pilot was very friendly.
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: Eric was the absolute best.  He spotted 3 whales for us.  The ride couldn't have been better.  We saw so many beautiful sights and it's something I'll never forget.  For our first trip to Kauai, it was magical.

Fantastic flight through the Alaska Range, through multiple high passes, along countless glaciers, close ups of key peaks including Denali, capped off by landing on a glacier. Lots of great pics. I'm not easily impressed - I've logged 8+ million miles in airplanes (including Himalaya flights), but Talkeetna Air Taxi ranks with the best. This was my wife's first flight in a small plane, and she had a grand time.  TAT does excellent job of orientation and safety briefing preparing passengers for everything.  The Turbine Otter was in top rig, and pilot preflights meticulous. I had opportunity to sit in jump seat and observe pilot throughout. Pilot is superbly skilled, great narrator, smooth as silk takeoffs and landings.  Underpinning a fantastic experience for passengers is a very apparent focus on safety.  Hope to fly with them again on next trip to Alaska.

review_title: See Kauai from the air with Air Ventures
review_text:
Flying with Air Ventures is not just a cheaper alternative to taking the more expensive helicopter tours!

You get a full hour tour with a great guide and pilot (Joel) to tour all of the major sights of the island and see things you cannot see from the ground.

The plane is specially designed for low speed flying and much quieter than the helicopters.  You get a headset and microphone to enable two way communication with the pilot.

You will see the harbor, the entire western coast (NaPali), Kalalau Valley, Hanalei Bay, Princeville, numerous waterfalls, the Powerline Trail, Mt. Waialeale, coffee plantations, Wailua Falls, and many other sights.

This was our fourth trip to Kauai but our first time to see the island from the air and it is well worth the money spent.  Don't book with any other airplane or helicopter tour.  Then report your experiences back to this website!

We took a family of 4 on the seaplane and neets Bay bear watching tour. Mike was our Pilot and he was great. 1st time we landed you didn’t even know you were on the water. The guide on the short walk was great as well and he makes sure you’re well informed. Overall the entire tour was great and a must do in Ketchikan.

review_title: Mt Denali glacier landing made the flight extra special!
review_text: The glacier landing makes this excursion really special.  Booked flight last minute in May 2016 bc of the CLEAR skies and gorgeous weather.  The day before was partly cloudy.  Not cheap ($750 for 2 w 15%off)  - a once in a lifetime bucket list thing.  Chose K2 due to glacier landing tour availability.  Didn't want to chance clouds for a next day booking with Talkeetna Air (another good service at lower price).   Make sure to bring good sunglasses and a fully charged camera device.
My wife and I enjoyed pleasant moments that made us return to the time of child. Very interesting also by the contact with several marine animals that inhabit this park
Mesmerizing and breathtaking views. Never seen anything like it. It was sunny and a great day to fly and visit the Denali peaks and glaciers. Worth every penny.

We stopped on our way out of Talkeetna AK.  The grounds, planes, houses all looked so beautiful and well kept we stopped more for a photo opp then to flightsee, we quickly changed our minds and decided to go for it. There were four of us we went for the 30 min. wildlife tour, which is priced right. They were very friendly and Jason our pilot did a wonderful job pointing out bears and other wild life as well as telling us about the area. It was one of the most awesome experiences we have had.

Wow, this was a great experience.  You really don't grasp the size of this mountain until you get up there in it, an awesome perspective that you can't get from the ground.  Our guide was Dallas, he was very personable, informative, and made us feel completely safe during the entire flight.  This flight was easily worth the price, I would do it again and Highly Recommend.
From takeoff to the extraordinary views from above was amazing. An unforgettable experience! Being the only ones viewing the 5 islands from a bird's eye in the entire world had me in awe.

review_title: Most amazing scenic flight of Denali
review_text: We chose the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing.  This was such an amazing experience.  We got so lucky with a beautiful sunny day and the landscape with so majestic.  Our flight tour guide was very informative! Highly recommend choosing this company!
We had an enjoyable ride and saw spectacular sights of the Grand Canyon.  Well informed tour.  Only downside it was half an hour rather than the 40 to 50 minutes suggested on booking.
Great flight, great views. the pilot was very informative and tried to get evryone a good view of the area

As an Alaskan resident, I don't do many touristy things in our beautiful state. The other half and I went on the Denali Experience tour and it was AMAZING! The pilot was fun, interactive and very informative. The office staff were pleasant. I wished I had done this a long time ago! I have driven this area and by these mountains hundreds of times but nothing compares to the up close and personal view of a flight seeing tour!!

The service, from being picked up downtown to our pilot, was first class!

The booking process with Leslie was easy and she was a pleasure to email back and forth with, answering all questions and accommodating us!

Checking in once we arrived was easy and everyone was extremely friendly.

Steve, our pilot, was great and explained what we were looking out at. The playlist on the headphones was spot on! The landing was much smoother than I thought it would be. The plane seemed to be in good shape and I'd assume they take good care of it.

Thanks for a great trip!

I was moved to tears by flying so close to the peak of Denali (and not because of fear).  It was a breathtaking experience and one I will never forget.  So incredibly beautiful and not something at our age we could have done on foot!  Our pilot said it best while he patted our airplane.  "I agree with you that this is a magical experience.  I think of these planes as our magic carpets."
We had a wonderful time - amazing views of Kauai that you can't get from any other means of travel.  Our pilot was personable and knowledgeable.

We took the "MistyFjords Flightseeing"on July 12,2024.  Thought it has been a while, we are still upset of the way we were taken care of for this tour.  Pilot, Clark, did not have a welcome word before the plane took off and either a thank you for us when we left.  He only had a few words during the flight and did not try to  make it a fun experience for us by letting us know of the areas we were flying over.  This  poor personality pilot should not be in that type of work to  deal with people on vacation.

This was hands-down the best decision we made during our whole trip! From start to finish, the women at TAT were friendly, knowledge, and extremely hospitable. We did the 1-1.5 hour Winter Adventurer tour and it was absolutely spectacular. Totally worth the price for this once in a lifetime trip!
From check in to flight everything was good.  JT was a very good and informational pilot. Was the first time flying over Kauai in a small plane

review_title: perfect flight from an outstanding team
review_text: had a brief delay only due to weather which is understandable since its a weather dependent excursion.  very nice and intimate plane ride although we rode with another cpl and gentleman me and the wife felt we were on a private flight.  i was impressed with the plane as it was built in 1956. It was very clean and well maintained. Our pilot did a perfect job of narrating enough as well as just letting us enjoy the vistas and scenery as when no one was talking we enjoyed the laid back songs he had on the headsets.  Not knowing when you actually leave the water and land again says a lot about the skills of our pilot.  The area had just recieved over 4 inches of rain in the previous days and we enjoyed every bit of the Tongass area with overspilling lakes and streams.  To say the flight was worth it after a while you just put down the iphone camera and just enjoy it because it was just too much to capture.  one thing that struck me was that the whole time as we boarded flew landed later on the mountain lake and headed back i never once felt like we were in a rush or that the pilot was on a strict timetable his intention was to allow us to see the area instead of it being on a stopwatch.  i would highly recommend this trip as it truly can be a once in a lifetime experience as theres no way to appreciate the area than by flying over it.  Would also like to thank the seawind team they let us at ease knowing that we could enjoy our trip and they would personally drive us back to our cruise ship since we had a shorter than normal port call.  so dont let a short port call dissuade you from booking , if they say you wont miss your ship ...you wont miss it.

The views were amazing and the staff and pilot were very friendly. We had a nearly 2 and 3 year old in our group and the staff were polite and patient with them. I definitely recommend and would do it again.

We were on our boat near River's Inlet and headed South to collect my brother and nephew who we were flying in for my nephew's 16th birthday present.  He had never been on a float plane or  on our boat outside of Puget Sound, so we were hoping for a memorable experience and NW Seaplanes started it our right and ended it right as well. 

They loved the flight up to Port McNeil and after 5 days flew out of Kwatsi Bay, no dock just climbing aboard on the plane floats!  It was a wonderful trip for all of us, but the great people at NW Seaplanes made it effortless.  The booking was easy and about $90 less per person than Kenmore with no diminished service.  If anything, it was better for us due to the Renton location and that they would fly in to Kwatsi.

While they left Renton on time, they were delayed in Nanaimo so an hour late to Port McNeil. They were also an hour late at Kwatsi, but it really didn't seem to matter to my nephew and brother as they loved the ride up and were glad to be delayed leaving Kwatsi and their holiday.

We will use NE Seaplanes again for sure and will recommend them
To people in the boating community and suggest they check them out when they check Kenmore routes and prices.  Both seem to be great options, but one may be better located, have more destinations, and the prices seem to be leas on NW Seaplanes.  Of course these are all up to each traveler, but we are a customer for sure.

Thanks NW Seaplanes for making gus 16th memorable.

Kathi

review_title: Great pilot, bad judgement on the part of the owner
review_text: We took this air tour around Kauai in late September. The weather in Kauai is often very unstable, and it was particularly so while we were there. It was pouring rain across the entire island the morning of the day we took our air tour, but when I called Air Ventures to make a reservation for two days later, there was a break in the weather. The owner (at least I believe he was the owner) told me that the conditions were great if I wanted to go that day, and that he could book me for that afternoon, so I did. When we arrived, we were told that all flights had been canceled that day because of bad weather but they were still hoping to get out that afternoon. We took off on schedule, and it was a beautiful tour, but Waimea canyon was completely socked in and we couldn't see it at all, and there were lots of clouds to contend with along the entire flight. I felt that we had been misled about the conditions that day, and if I had known that the weather would be so unstable I wouldn't have booked the trip. Also, if I did it again I'd go in a helicopter. We saw helicopters touring the canyon and the coast later during our stay and they could get much closer to the sights and provide better views. Still, the pilot was great and overall it was a good experience. But I was terribly disappointed at not seeing the canyon.

review_title: Most beautiful tour available, with the best people! Whether you're a pilot or just wish you were, flying with Wings Over Kauai
review_text: Whether you're a pilot of any level, or a non pilot, flying over Kauai with Wings Over Kauai is a great experience! Jacob was my instructor/ tour guide and was one of the best people I had the pleasure of meeting during my week on the island. He and Ellen met my wife and I with enthusiasm and professionalism and insured our flight was what we wanted and expected. The flight itself was beautiful from takeoff to landing(my 50th state), and although not inexpensive, was one of the best ways to spend a couple of hours on Kauai!

This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska! We thoroughly enjoyed Tim as our pilot and gave us a smooth pleasurable flight. We landed at Base Camp on Mt McKinley, got to walk around & take lots of pictures! It was amazing and well worth the money! I recommend you do it😍 Ask for Tim he was Great!!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: The whole experience was touristy and underwhelming.   We had visited the south side of the canyon Years before and found it more inspiring and beautiful.  DO NOT waste $ on the Skywalk....you can't take photos and must rely on the site photographers.   Disappointed.

Wonderful experience from beginning to end.  Thanks to Arnie for being a great ambassador for Maverick!  He took care of us in an royal way at the counter and the trip only got better and better.  Well worth your time and money.  We took the 9 am Canyon Spirit trip today.  The perfect way to see the vastness of this beautiful canyon.  The ride was very smooth with great visibility and good headphones to block the noise.  Easy to hear our great pilot, (his name escapes me, but it started with a B...).  Definitely the company to choose for a 5 star experience.

review_title: Tour of the Big Islland Volcano
review_text: This is the longest flight offered but well worth the trip.  We flew over along the North shore /Hana side of Maui. Zipped over the blue Pacific for 45 minutes or so to the Big Island.
