Saw hot lava pots, but nothing was flowing into the sea that day.  Very exciting to see how large the area is and how the volcano had changed the country side.  Enjoyed a stop over in Hilo and bought Eric breakfast for all his kindness and concern about our trip.   Would do it again.

Even though we had some cloudy conditions, our pilot, Eric, managed to find us some glorious views of the NaPali coast and numerous waterfalls in the canyons.  The staff on the ground were friendly and helpful as well.  This was a repeat tour for us (previous one 2 years ago) so we were expecting a great tour and got one!

It is hard to pick to pick a favorite part of the tour as the whole experience was beyond words.
We would definitely pick the glacier landing as a must.  We could not have had a more perfect day as there was not a cloud anywhere.  Our pilot (Chris) was an encyclopedia of information  about the history of the area and the mountain.  As long time residents of Alaska  I don’t know how we could have had a better experience and would definitely recommend it to everyone and it should be on everyone’s bucket list.

review_title: Amazing views even more amazing staff and crew!
review_text: 10 out of 10 from start to finish!  The shuttle picked us up on time and the driver was a delight!  The staff was friendly and professional, helping my dad to, from, onto and off of the seaplane although he needs a walker to get around (slowly).  A shout out to Lesley for her kindness and patience.  A shout out to Max for piloting the seaplane with commentary of his own engagement and wedding events at various locations throughout our flight.  Loved those personal stories and your musical playlist! A shout out to the dock crew as well!  Thanks everyone (and the three sweet golden retrievers) at SeaWind Aviation!

My wife and I took a Mountain Voyager w/ Glacier Landing trip for her birthday. The whole trip was incredible; the views were amazing throughout, the glacier landing allows you to get a real sense of the immense scale and the pilot/guide was friendly and gave very interesting commentary. The flight was smooth and we felt completely safe throughout.

We were very happy with WOK - the service was awesome! Customer service was exceptional from the necklace given to me at the beginning of the flight to the DVD show given to us at the end. We also received a great photo in our email that was taken of us in front of the plane before takeoff. The ride was comfortable and the views were amazing. Definitely choose to fly with them the next time you're here!

review_title: What a Thrill!! Take the Red Snoopy II BiPlane!
review_text: Incredible adventure!  We didn't want the norm, so we booked a Bi Plane trip of a lifetime on Snoopy II.  Our very experienced pilot Kevin was entertaining and knowledgeable about the island.  He gave us THE smooothest takeoff and landing we've ever experienced in any plane!  What a hoot!  He talked to us continuously on the headsets telling us what we were looking at.  Such amazing views!  Wear comfy clothes. No need for a jacket, the engine of the plane keeps you warm.  Best deal for your tourist $$ while in Hawaii!! I will go again if I ever get the opportunity!  Thanks Kevin and the friendly staff of Air Adventures for a memorable vacation experience!!  Janice and Jack

Our recent trip( Sept 24-Oct3) to Hawaii was highlighted  by a flight with Bruce of  Wings over Kauai.  He was both professional and knowledge in his dealings with us.  As a pilot myself, I felt very secure with Bruce.  Skip the shaking and noise of the helicopters, and enjoy  the flight with Wings over Kauai, its alot less in price.

review_title: Better price than Princess excursions AND the highlight of our trip!!
review_text: This is a must do trip!!!  Charge it and pay it off slowly. skip dinner, wear the same clothes a little longer, eat pasta for a year, this is worth EVERY PENNY!!!  During our 24 hours in the area, the clouds parted and we sprung into action trying to book a flight and glacier landing.  The Princess excursions were all booked, but they recommended calling Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Their prices were better and they were extremely accommodating working with our schedule and 9 people to make sure we had an incredible experience!   The staff was friendly, the pilot was extremely knowledgeable of the area and highly qualified to fly!  The view was UNBELIEVABLE, BREATHTAKING and something we will all (aged 10 to 76) NEVER forget!  There are no words or pictures to describe the beauty!
The view was fantastic. The weather was great. Even got to see several groups of whales from the air.

review_title: Great tour of breathtaking landscapes, we even saw whales from the plane!
review_text:
My husband and I took an Air Ventures Kauai tour in the air van, and we loved it!

We chose the air van (6 person plane) because the cost was substantially cheaper than a helicopter tour. We heard from locals that all the planes and helicopters take the same route. We also liked that it uses less fuel than helicopters!

We loved how the plane took us over the Waimea canyon, and we loved the views of the rugged Napali coast. However, our favourite part was when we saw 6-7 humpback whales from the plane. The pilot circled around the whales for a few minutes so we could take it in.

I truly have to say this was one of my favorite vacation activities that my wife and I have ever done on a vacation. Kauai is a beautiful treasure and seeing it from the air is the best way to get the total experience. The staff was awesome - Val was very friendly and thorough in preparing us for flight and Captain Marcus made the ride truly enjoyable. His narration of the island and his great piloting skills made for a memorable time. We chose this plane tour over the many helicopter tours in the area since we would be guaranteed a window seat - no middle seats on the plane.  Getting a middle seat on a helicopter which would totally ruin the experience. The flight was smooth and safe. Great experience - highly recommend.

review_title: Air Ventures Recreated the island of Kauai for me!
review_text: After approximately 3 years of living on Kauai, I finally had the opportunity to take an air tour of the island and I was blown away. I had no idea the image of this island in my head was so far off from what it really looks like from the air. The pilot, Harry, was perfect! He knew what he was talking about and made it seem like we were out with a friend who happened to be a pilot. He was great. I highly recommend Air Ventures!

As a frequent visitor of Hawaii having my mind blown so many times over is amazing. Eric is the a great pilot and tour guild. Having your own plane, taking control and pictures of this unreal scenery. Do Not Miss out!!!

Great people, great pilot. Excellent tour!
We had to reschedule the next day due to weather. Everything went smooth.

review_title: Float Plane Trip to Misty Fjords
review_text: Our Cruise Line chose Taquan Air for our Misty Fjords float plane excursion.  The Misty Fjords were beautiful, and our pilot did get us there and back safely.  However, our pilot, Mike, was the most uninterested, disengaged, least helpful guide we had our entire trip.  His total lack of engagement with our party nearly ruined the beautiful scenery.
Great tour..sights never able to see any other way..highly recommend..must see when in Alaska! Totally worth it...

One of the best values on the island.  Bruce and Ellen are terrific people and making your flight the best ever is obviously their goal.  Bruce is a great pilot and with his agriculture background he was a wealth of information about island farming and has an abundance of knowledge about the island history. Little touches, like the photo they provide, involving you in pre-flight check and  the necklace presented on arrival, made this a special tour.  The island is truly a Garden Isle and the views seen during flight are ones you would never see otherwise.  This was actually the last thing we did before leaving the island and we saw the parts we were unable to see by car.  We had a truly memorable experience and one we would probably do again.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen for making our trip to Kauii complete.

review_title: Experience the Grand Canyon in AWE
review_text: I took my elderly parents on this trip, given their age I figure an airplane ride would be a lot softer on their nerves. They would not stop admiring the greatness of nature, the ability of the pilot to maneuver and present both sides of the seventh wonder to either side of the plane. This is the only way to take what the Grand Canyon offer, I was so satisfied that I would do it all over again

This was one of te best things I have done on Kauai. The cost was one half of ahelicopter and the views were just as good. We were treated very well. The oilot was very good and the office lady was friendly and a as a couple they just fit well. The flight was over 1 hour. The views were awesum. The pilot was on with good commentary and backround on sites, movies, and the beauty of KauaiWe had driven all over the islad and seen all we could via car. This top view was greate. DVD after the flight was a nice touch it was a short stock of the high spots that we saw. Very good.
Magnifique expérience avec un pilote sympathique et expérimenté.Merci Kim! Ce survol était magique! Paysages magnifiques.

Amazing! So beautiful to see the Hana Coast from above. We saw All the waterfalls:) Some way into the back country. Eric is a wonderful Pilot... we felt so cared for. Highly recommend. It was thrilling!!

user_location: New York, New York, United States
review_text: I am very afraid of flying in anything so I was extremely apprehensive to go on the tour. Even before we got onto the plane, our guide began to erase my fears. He did his best throughout the flight to keep me engaged even while telling us all of the rich history of Kauai. I would definitely go again and use Air Ventures Hawaii to do so. Mahalo!

We did the Norcal Coastal Tour and enjoyed every minute of the flight. It was an amazing, unforgettably beautiful event which we cleary recommend to do. Not really cheap, but special memories are rarely cheap. Do it and enjoy it!

review_title: Great value and great time - really worth your time
review_text:
I had made the reservation before I had landed there.  Once we landed in the resort, the resort folks were pushing for their own companies.  But I chose to stick with this company based on the reviews that I had read in Trip Advisor and also on how easy it was to book the trip.  
We showed up on Sunday at the appointed time.  Mary (owner's daughter) received us and completed the sign in and safety procedures.  Since there was just 4 of us flying that day, we were excited because we had the whole plane to ourselves.
Mary took more photos of us in the cockpit and the plane.  Bruce stopped by and talked to us.
I was sitting on the co-pilot's seat and all the rest of my family including my wife, daughter, and son got the window seats.
The whole ride was really smooth and not any way close to was not bumpy as we were expecting.  Bruce was extremely knowledgeable and explained the Napali coast and everything in between in detail.  He also gave us a lot of history on he area.  We went over all the West chores, Napali coast, turned to East and North shore and landed in an hour.  The whole ride went by so fast because of how much picturesque the whole area was but also based on how interesting Bruce made the whole ride to be.
After the trip, Mary gave us a CD of the photos and also mailed the photos and thanked us.  My kids mentioned that it was a highlight of their trip.
Thanks Bruce and Mary - the whole experience was great and I will HIGHLY recommend.

Amazing experience, we didn't book a flight but bought one right away. Since we were in a group, we got a 15% discount (plus taxes), better than we would get online. The flight took 2 hours and we stood for 30min in the glacier nearby Mt. Mckinley, where we could walk around. Thanks to our wonderful pilot, Chris, we landed on a beautiful site where there was no one else. Super recommend it!

We did a lot of research before we went and ended up booking with Maverick due to the trip advisor reviews. So glad we did. It was amazing and whilst the Grand Canyon would be amazing with any of the tour companies, Maverick were faultless. Great pilot and very knowledgable, took off on time, super helicopter and all round great customer service.

My husband and I went on a Maverick Helicopter tour to the Grand Canyon.  It was a brilliant experience definitely is a bucket list thing to do.

The only criticism I would say is it was advertised picnic with Champagne when we reached the Grand Canyon and this consisted of plastic containers that had a few sliced celery and carrot sticks which were not fresh, cheese and cracker snack packet and one plastic cup of bubbly.  This could have been much better.
They were absolutely great. They were very informative. Pointed out a lot of scenery. I will be back.

I went on this flight experience with my 10 year old son and it was absolutely amazing!  Worth every penny and then some.  An experience we will never forget.  Nothing but professional and safe pilot.  My 10 year old was able to fly a lot too.

Really a great tour.  The flight was longer than the helicopter tours and we got to see everything from a window seat.  I've been on helicopter tours which I think are better if you actually land somewhere, otherwise the plane is just as good and much less expensive.  Our pilot, Desi, was a real trip, super enthusiastic and a lot of fun to be with.  Our flight was the afternoon after a heavy rain day so there were an unbelievable number of waterfalls.

I have rowed from Sausalito in the bay, sailed on the bay, cycled to the top of the Marin Headlands, hiked in West Marin, but this is the only flight that I have taken that almost touched the top of the Golden Gate Bridge and gave me a different view of the water. Wow!  That's all I can say.  Spectacular!  A sheer joy!  I loved every minute of our excursion for two.  The take off and landing on the water was an added bonus.  A must do....even for locals like me.  What a perspective you get of the most beautiful place to be.
Very informative .   Greatest opportunity for pictures..  I enjoyed the private flight and highly recommend

Excellent,the staff were very helpful and the experience was great. 
We booked from Australia so there was a lot of emailing but they answered every time which helped with the uncertainty of being so far away.

We  started our Kauai vacation with an air tour with Wings Over Kauai and it proved to be a wonderful way to see the island.  The entire experience from first greeting to final goodbye was superb and we would highly recommend this company.  Everyone was gracious and thoughtful and very solicitous. The tour was amazing and we enjoyed the beauty of the island, the expert narrative, and the thrill of flying. We also appreciated the ginger chews that were offered...yummy!

review_title: Cancelled on us with no warning
review_text:
We booked our Grand Canyon flight with Maverick several weeks in advance.  We called the morning of our flight to confirm that we would be there, and Maverick thanked us for confirming.  When we arrived, we were told that an earlier flight had been cancelled due to weather/clouds in the Grand Canyon (no one mentioned this when we called to confirm).  When it was time for our flight, we were told ours was cancelled as well.  

We scrambled to find another helicopter tour company.  We called three, and all of them were carrying out their tours as scheduled (which indicated to us that the weather was fine, which we also observed on our own, since it was pretty much beautiful outside).  Unfortunately, since Maverick gave us absolutely no warning, we were too late-- all three other companies were booked.  Maverick did not offer to reschedule us or even apologize at all; just acted like this was business as usual.

Trusting Maverick was simply heartbreaking.  We may never make it back to the Grand Canyon, and our opportunity to take a helicopter tour over the canyon was lost, maybe forever.  Book with anyone, literally anyone else, besides Maverick.

review_title: You need luck for a good view
review_text: I found this experience very disappointing. Seating aboard the helicopter is determined by your weight. If you are on the right side of the helicopter you will get a good view. I sat at the back on the left with my wife sat in the middle at the back. She got a very obstructed view throughout. Because the light was shining mainly from left to right when we saw the best view of the canyon lit up I was not able to get a good view of the red/pink rock. The pilot did not take the helicopter round so that we could see the pretty rocks and at the end of the flight I felt rather cheated. The cost was $309 per person and it is pot-luck where you are allocated and if you are unlucky as we were you may also be thoroughly disappointed by the experience.
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_title: Great value, awesome pilot and wonderful views
review_text:
I had been looking at this flight since we began planning our trip to Kauai,  but was still on the fence . We did a helicopter tour of the Big Island 20 years ago and kept wondering if it was worth double the price to go on a helicopter here.  On our first day we drove out to Waimea Canyon and there we made our choice.  We saw the plane and a helicopter pass over us and decided the plane looked great.

We booked the flight online 10:30 am (later we heard a pilot share this was the best time but honestly I don't think you could go wrong either time. )

Got to the airport and checked in a little later our pilot Nick came by and welcomed us. Walked out to the plane did a little safety brief, low door watch your head and so on, then loaded the plane for the typical over the water flight, loved the bit of humor with the air sickness bag and taxid out to the runway. 
Nick is a wonderful young pilot, those folks seem to be getting younger every year, or .aybe it's just me. Local guy, no doubt loves what he does and where he lives. Offered a great tour pointing out highlights and the coolest thing was making some left hand turns for those of us on the other side of the plane. Great pilot he banked us over so we could get some great pictures and did it so SMOOTHLY that we hardly noticed.
We took some incredible pictures and a few videos of the entire island. It was really cool having him point out places we had visited and see it from the air.
Wish there was a higher rating we could give. Highly recommend this trip 👌  best value and awesome views, what a combo!
Use my name when you get there they won't remember me just say little round guy big smile, grinned the rest of the day. Book it book it now
.  Can't wait to come back and do it again.
This has to be the best way to see SF - informative and entertaining tour, whales and seals as well as fantastic scenery and overflying the Golden Gate, City and Alcatraz - (very smooth flight!)
Had a great trip back to Talkeetna from Caribou Lodge Alaska. The staff there were so friendly and helpful. The flight was very smooth and the pilot was friendly.

review_title: great time in the sky over Kauai
review_text: We really enjoyed the flight and the pilot was a lot of fun. Awesome way to get a feel for the entire island. we had the previlage of seeing the top of the mountain unobscured by the clouds.

review_title: One of the highlights of our Alaskan trip
review_text:
We really debated whether to do this or not - it's expensive.  But after having gone, I have to say it's well worth it.  You get views you just can't get any other way - including the summit of all three major mountains which most people never get to see from the ground because they're obscured by clouds.  Our pilot - Dave - found a hole in the clouds, popped up on top for an outstanding view.  And make sure you include the glacier landing in your trip.  The whole experience was awesome.  

While there are other air services in Talkeetna, we really liked Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Excellent service, loved the pilot (very experienced and flew the plane very well), great narration along the whole trip.  The planes were clean and looked to be well maintained.  We felt extremely safe the whole time.  

If you can possibly work this into your vacation - do it.  Well worth every dollar!
This was great. The views were amazing. I haven’t had a ride in an airplane since my dad gave me a ride and this was amazing

review_title: " Fantastic Services, friendly and just awesome"
review_text: Me and my friend were picked up at Pier 39 and driven to the location to takepart . The gentlemen driver was great giving us commentary as we drove along,"he didn't have to do this "  The ride was fantastic alone. The flight was breathtaking, i cant explain in words....We were in the air what felt along time,not up in air and land soon after. The pilot was very Informative and also you could tell he enjoyed doing this !!! "fantastic " Also we were given a ride back to pier 39.

Do it. Do it now. Book this activity. This was the best activity my wife & I did together in the USA. The plane is awesome & the pilot, exceptional. Over peak season when we did it many people used this activity to get tickets to Alcatraz. Forget Alcatraz. Just do this. The whole trip was as smooth as silk flying over the bay area, Golden Gate (yes it came out of the mist for us), Alcatraz and downtown. The commentary, jokes, cajolling & interaction between pilot & passengers was excellent. 
They also picked us up & dropped as at the pier area in SF so we did not have to drive.
Will definitely do this again.

We spent a weekend in San Francisco and wanted to do something out of the ordinary.  We took the 60 minute Norcal Coastal Tour and highly recommend it.  Spent the morning in Sausalito and met our pilot after lunch.  It's kind of fun to take off and land on the water.  Very smooth ride and great commentary from the pilot along the way.  It was just my wife and I with the pilot so she got to ride co-pilot.  The first half of the tour is up the coast with views of several light houses, it would be fun to do this during whale season and spot them from the air, no such luck on this day.  The second half of the tour is over Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and San Francisco.  Not something you would do every day but the 60 minute tour was just right, not too long and not too short.

review_title: Seeing the Island as never before!
review_text: We have been to Kauai before and love the island, This time we took the air tour with Air Ventures. What a great choice. Harry our pilot was great. The island holds so many magical and majestic beauties. A must for any visitor to the Island of Kauai..

review_title: You could pay for a helicopter tour or if your a pilot, you can fly.
review_text: I flew WOKTs 2001 injected Skyhawk from takeoff to landing around the island of Kauai. Luckily, I had a BFR 2 months earlier in an old Skyhawk flying 4 hours with an instructor. I'm a 250 hour private pilot.  Bruce, the owner and flight instructor was very user friendly. I few the aircraft 95% of the time. If your a pilot, you got to do this! The views were spectacular.

This was one of the best flying experiences I’ve had in my life. I fly aircraft down south but this was still shocking how incredible the view was. Our pilot Leighan was one of the best pilots I’ve flown with. Great company and staff, can’t thank them enough!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Totally awesome and amazing.  You have to see AK from the air to appreciate the size and beauty.   K2 folks were fantastic!

review_title: This is the best air tour, forget the rest!
review_text:
We had the best customer service I think I have ever experienced. The flight over the island was amazing but made really special by the hospitality we received.

We had the friendliest service ever by really genuine people who seem totally engaged with giving us the best possible experience, which is exactly what we got.

Jill went over and above our expectations and really went the extra mile to make the flight happen for us which we really appreciated.

Kevin was a great pilot, his knowledge of the island is amazing, he really put us at ease and made the flight feel safe, very informative and fun.

If you are planning on doing a Kauai scenic flight forget the rest, Air Ventures are the absolute best, I can't recommend them enough!

I've been to Arches before, but I really SAW it for the first time today. Chris, our pilot, was informative, comfortable to be with, and made Arches and Canyonlands a whole new, incredible experience. Almost didn't do it. But it will be the story I tell for years about this trip.

I have enjoyed the thrill of a helicopter tour on Kaua’i but feel that this was a far more relaxing and scenic way to see the island. We did luck out and have the perfect weather. Not a bump and the clouds seemed to part wherever we went. Maybe it was our pilot.

review_title: A wonderful first time experience on a seaplane
review_text: My family and I booked a package tour with Friday Harbor Seaplanes and Western Prince Explorer Whale Watching. We all had a great and comfortable time on the flight, which felt safe, but also exhilarating. Our pilots were knowledgable and professional as well. During this package deal we had enough to time enjoy Friday Harbor before doing the whale watch tour part. Thank you for this fun tour and I look forward to booking with this trustworthy company again.

j'avais essayé de reserver de Paris , mais cela semblait compliqué pour confirmer en anglais , alors lors de notre ballade en vélo sur Sausalito , nous nous sommes arretes et nous avons
rencontré un compatriote qui nous a tout expliqué en francais , il m a meme permis de me 
mettre à la place du pilote , nous avons reservé pour le lundi apres midi. le matin du lundi le
golden etait sous la brume , grrrrrrrr , lors de notre arrivée et apres un petite attente la brume
s est levée et nous avons décollé , Paul le pilote à fait le job , super tour d avion , explication et
surtout il ma laissé le manche pendant la moitie du parcours , le pied total , piloter un avion au 
dessus de San Francisco et du Golden Gate ; inoubliable. ( précision , je suis pilote en France )

encore un grand merci à notre hote francais ( John ) et notre pilote Paul.

Took the nearly one hour Canyon Spirit flight with a totally great pilot (Felix). The helicopter was modern and compact, with excellent views for all the passengers (looked a lot newer than some other companies). Felix was ex-Navy, a really great pilot and entertaining guide, who put us completely at our ease whilst giving us one of the most spectacular and memorable experiences ever. There were 6 passengers on the flight, all of us delighted, and happy squeals of enjoyment and excitement as we flew around were common. It cost a bit, but made the Canyon an exceptional experience.

As two retired couples, we looked forward to our scenic flight over the island of Kauai as part of our Hawaii vacation aboard the NCL cruise ship "Pride of America" - and we were very happy with the entire experience. We were picked up near the pier by our friendly host Bruce and taken to the airport to register with another friendly staff member - Sophia. Although our foursome turned into a threesome due to an illness, we had the plane to ourselves  - with Paul, our pilot, showing us the sights of this beautiful island throughout the 65 minute ride. From the southern beaches to the coffee plantations to the gorgeous Waimea Canyon to the breathtakingly impressive Na Pali coast to the numerous waterfalls of the Hanalei Valley, our trip was an amazing experience. Upon returning, we received an unexpected gift - a DVD containing a video recap of our flight itinerary. We were then personally driven back to the ship by our gracious hostess Ellen. It was a truly wonderful morning!  I heartily recommend "Wings Over Kauai" as a great way to see the sights of the island at a very reasonable price.

review_title: Fun and amazing views of the whole island
review_text: Have done helicopter tour but liked this airplane ride much better. Kevin, our pilot, was great! Experienced as a pilot, funny and very knowledgeable, he gave us a great tour over Kauai. Not just pointing out  landmarks, he gave us recommendations on snorkeling, history of the island and much more. Highly recommend!!

The scenery was terrific, but the exciting aspect of our trip was actually landing on the glacier.  On September 8, 2021, the sun was playing tag with fluffy white clouds. When we landed on the glacier and exited the plane for a walk, we were entertained by the suns rays appearing behind huge black rock pinnacles. K2 furnished us with non-slip boots that were worn over our boots, and the footing was secure.  Our pilot was very talented and explained the terrain as we flew over varying vistas.

The entire experience was professional, friendly, informative, and FUN. Our Captain, Bill, was informative, safety conscious, and easy to talk to. The deHavillian Beaver We were fortunate to take on our flight was a bonus. Great low and slow aircraft. Love it. Saw so much on our1 hour flight. Do not pass up the chance to take this trip or other services with J2 Aviation.

review_title: Amazing Aerial Views with Wings Over Kauai - Awesome!
review_text:
My husband & I were visiting Kauai from New York.  We were extremely fortunate to fly in a comfortable but small plane to view the luscious island of Kauai.  When we arrived for our flight Val was there to help us and handle all of our questions.  Our pilot Josh was extremely knowledgeable, friendly & provided us with a wonderful tour!  The enthusiasm Josh had definitely matched mine!  We had another couple on our flight & it took Josh much energy to get us speaking especially since the other couple was a little quiet. Flight skill was superb!  We noticed the little things, especially the coffee fields, & we came away feeling like it was such a worth while experience.

We highly recommend this trip!  You get a different view of Kauai, in that, while you don't hover over the valleys like you would in helicopters, you get up close to see the valleys and the surrounding lush island. In other words, a definite better perspective of the surrounding natural environment of Kauai. Wings Over Kauai really put in small touches to make it a better experience for your trip.  This trip is longer than most helicopter excursions in Hawaii & you don't bounce around as much.   This is a must do in Kauai!  :-)

I was in Alaska for 11 days and while I saw many amazing things, this Flightseeing was definitely at the top of my favorites. The narration was excellent, the flight itself was comfortable and the views were just out of this world. Would highly recommend this company and this particular tour--well worth it!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: This tour was amazing! our tour guide Henry was spectacular and provided us with great history of the island and answered all of our questions! we got to see a lot of different sites and experience different climates all on the same island! will differently visit again
tour_name: 15-Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu32_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: This activity was the highlight of our entire 10 day trip. It was amazing to see all the mountains, waterfalls and hidden canyons that you cannot see from the water or the coast. The beauty of Kauai is just breathtaking. Our pilot Marcus was a friendly and knowledgeable tour guide. He kept the plane perfectly smooth and comfortable. Highly recommended!

Wir haben unseren Urlaub auf Kauai mit einem Rundflug begonnen und für den Anbieter "Wings over Kauai" entschieden. Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und alles wurde uns ausführlich erklärt. Der Flug mit Bruce war der absolute Hammer. Wir haben uns von Anfang an sehr wohl bei Ihm gefühlt. Er ist humorvoll und hat uns sehr viele Infos und Tips gegeben. Wir können "Wings over Kauai" zu 100 % weiterempfehlen. Es ist ein einmaliges Erlebnis was bei einem Urlaub auf Kauai nicht fehlen sollte. Vielen lieben Dank an das gesamte Team, Ihr seit großartig.

As part of our Celebrity Cruise-tour we took a floatplane excursion to Misty-Fjords. Our pilot for our Taquan Air tour was a retired UPS pilot who retired from Louisvilleour home town. Though it was raining in Ketchikan, as usual, it was a great day to fly. He was right we flew out of the rain and the sights were breath-taking. We landed on a small body of water that was beautifully calm with a small waterfall empting into it. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and we highly recommend this tour.

Wonderful exposure with breathtaking views and a knowledgeable, friendly tour guide/pilot, Eric. He was great with my young autistic son, and we all learned a lot about our islands. And of course, we saw lots of whales, so we’re all happy!!

review_title: Got our own private flight because the other passengers on our group flight were too fat! Awesome treat!
review_text:
My girlfriend and I booked a group flight around the Island. 

I have flying experience and when we arrived and it was time to go out to the plane, we were surprised to get a private flight for two on their Cessna 182T, instead of the group flight we booked on the ten seater. Observing the other passengers, half of them were overweight, and I suspect behind the scenes they arranged for us two to have our own plane because the other plane was too heavy to take-offf with their excessive weight! It was a real treat because the private flight should have been more like $700 instead of the $300 we paid for a one hour flight,

Our pilots name was Bud, I think?  He was a young guy, with only a few years flying experience.  I think I soloed before he was even born?   He was building hours and hoping to get hired by Hawaiian Airmon the Airbus 320Neo.  I wish him the best of luck because 20 years ago that was my plan to  for their lines. Plans changed though. 

It was an amazing flight.  Haven’t flown in a small Cessna for over twenty years. It was great to get back in the air in a small GA plane.

review_title: Amazing aerial tour of the bay area!
review_text: We had so much fun on the seaplane, we can't wait to do it again when we have visitors! It is an incredible perspective on the city and surrounding area and our pilot, Bruce, had great information to share throughout the trip. Can't recommend this enough!

The mountain was excellent, got a good feel as we flew close to the mountains wall.  Landing and throwing a snow ball was great

If you question the cost
I wished we could have stayed a little more on the mountain

You get a minute to take pictures of who your with by the plane

But you dont get enough time to actually  stand there and do a real 360 and actually look at the mountain close

K2 is a business 
The more people they fly, the more they make

If your wanting to see Denali
Spend your money on a flight and land on the mountian 
Dont waste money on bus

Had a fantastic trip with the fantastic Capt. Harry. Thank you for the wonderful and informative tour, not to mention the breathtaking, incredible views! I am so glad we opted for Airventures vs. a helicopter tour, as it is the clear winner in terms of views and comfort. Highly recommend!
Our flight was awesome!, and our pilot even better!!, we enjoyed so much the flight and our pilot was very nice, I would definitely recommend it.

We booked with Wings Over Kauai while visiting on the Pride of America. Our flight was on 9/27/2012 and we had Cap't Josh. It was beyond amazing!!! We walked over to the ABC store- a very short walk from the ship- and Bruce picked us up. Sophia and Ciera got us all checked in and ready for our flight. And Ellen gave us a ride back to the Marriott by the ship when we were done, so we met all the staff and everybody was so nice and helpful! The flight itself was just stunning. Kauai was our favorite of the islands and this tour was our favorite tour by far! We all had mics so we could talk with Josh and ask questions and he did a great job of pointing things out and answering our questions. I would definitely do this tour again if I'm ever lucky enough to be back in Kauai!! Mahola, Stan and Mary- Texas

review_title: the Best way to see this amazing city
review_text: I have been to San Francisco 5 times now and seen all the great attractions here.But this time did this awesome floatplane trip with my dad.Wow, a whole new amazing perspective on the sights, and a ton of new things that you just can’t see from the ground.The company were great, organised, friendly and informative.The aircraft are well maintained and in great condition.You need this experience

The flight was spectacular!!! I saw the tallest sea cliffs in the world, along with beautiful waterfalls and native fish ponds. I learned a lot and it was all I could have asked for and more! Our guide, Steve, was very informative and made the trip a wonderful experience. I highly recommend taking a flight! Now I want to sign up for more - it is amazing to see the islands from the air!

Our family of 5 adults and 4 kids (ages 11 to 6) just returned from a 2 weeks Alaska cruisetour.  One of the highlights was flying to the glacier and landing with K2.

It was obvious that safety came first with this company and the pilot's knowledge of the area and the glacier was such an added bonus.

As to the cost, do not hesitate.  It is well worth every penny!

We had a spectacular flight with our pilot, Chris.  We felt like we could of reached out and touched the granite walls of the mountains.  Had a great glacier landing and experience.  One of the real hi lights of our Alaska experience.
This was a really great experience! The views were phenomenal and our pilot was very knowledgeable and took us places we would have never seen if we weren’t flying over!

review_title: グランドキャニオンへ一直線。
review_text: 双発のレシプロ小型機でボルダー飛行場から約一時間の飛行です。行きはフーバーダムの上空を飛びグランドキャニオンへひとっ飛び景色も最高でした。機内のヘッドホンからは、日本語アナウンスも有り良い旅でした。小型機ですから少し揺れます。

Everything from the maintenance of the planes, to the smoothness of the flight, to the comfort during our time in the air, to the breathtaking views of Multnomah below us, this experience was definitely one we were glad to try out! Our flight was safely captained by KJ, who did a really great job of thoroughly explaining the sights we saw down below and made sure the flight was smooth and enjoyable!

My boyfriend, a long-time small plane pilot himself, booked our K2 flight as a last-minute surprise for me when we visited Talkeetna at the end of September, 2021.  

We received excellent service from the first telephone call to stepping down from the plane, post-flight.  Every staff member we interacted with provided terrific service.

Our pilot was highly experienced, extremely competent, knowledgeable, communicated very well and flew with our safety and comfort as his first priority.  

He was an excellent guide and I would fly with him repeatedly.
My escort was highly impressed with his skills and called him "a pilot's pilot."  

I cannot rate this experience highly enough.  There are no words to express the grandeur of flying among the mountain peaks and over glaciers, rivers and the Alaskan tundra in the late afternoon sun.  It was stunningly beautiful.  Taking photos from a viewpoint simply cannot compare to seeing the mountain range in person.  Denali is "the great one" indeed!

It was a once in a lifetime experience that was gifted to me by a wonderful man...and yes, I will do it again just as soon as I can!

FYI, I don't normally post reviews, but this experience was so great that I had to write about it.  Go have your own grand adventure with K2.  You'll regret it if you don't!

review_title: Bird’s Eye View of Puget Sound and Seattle
review_text: This is the best way to experience the grandeur and beauty of Puget Sound, Mt, Rainier and Seattle.  Don’t miss out the chance!
Absolute amazing, circle island tour was so incredible. My photo library is full of incredible photos and I spent most of the trip just soaking everything in.

I flew with TAT to Denali and that was a very good experience. However me and my wide were disappointed on the way back. My wife was staying in Talkeetna while I was on the mountain and she wanted to surprise me by coming on the plane to base camp to welcome me there. Everything was set when she showed up at TAT office early in the morning. But because of winds flights were delayed so she was told not to wait there but come back after 11am. To her great disappointment when she got back the plane had already taken off! So she missed the opportunity... It looks that communication from TAT might have been a bit more precise...

review_title: Could not have asked for better!!
review_text: Could not have asked for better! Eric was an amazing pilot but even more so,  very informative and easy going.  Answered all of our questions about the different islands and history of the area. Extremely helpful on, off and inside the plane.
Up close and personal Airal view of Kauai. Our first time but not our last! Its a slow ride completely around Kauai with excellent views of everything. Great for photo taking. Thank you Air Venture.

This excursion was booked after our helicopter/glacier tour got canceled due to weather...and I’m so glad we did it! The flight was stunning and smooth! The scenery was just spectacular, especially when we landed! Our guide was excellent...The treck  through the rain forest to the viewing platform was very smooth and absolutely gorgeous! We saw 5 black bears and a cub! They  fished  and ate - the mama fed her baby - we saw two of them get into a brief skirmish over their fishing spot!! It was one of our  favorite excursions!

This was a really great experience- Sergio, our pilot, was excellent, the flight was super smooth (first time in a small plane, so I was a little nervous), but everything went great. We got some amazing views, and even had a nice sunset for the first part of the tour before getting some truly spectacular views of Miami and South Beach at night. Definitely give it a shot, you won't retret it!

We got excellent weather after days of rain and snow, absolutely worth the price. TAT employees were great to deal with on the phone and in person.  I'd waited 11 years to come back to AK and see Denali from the air.

review_title: Best Value to See Kauai By Air
review_text:
My huband, daughter, brother, and sister-in-law toured with WOK on June 10.  The pre-flight check in was very informative - given by Bruce and Ellen's daughter, Mary.  And Bruce was just fantastic as the pilot and guide.  We've been to Kauai numerous times, but had not toured the island by air.  This really gave us the perspective we had been missing.  So much of the island isn't accessible by anything other than air and as such, we were able to see so many sights we had previously missed. 

As others have noted, Bruce manuevered the plane to allow all to get pictures of Na Pali and the waterfalls.  The scenery is just breathtaking!  Helicopter tours may get you closer, but in my opinion, it just isn't worth the significant increase in cost.  WOK is one of the best values we have found for exploring Kauai and highly recommend this company and its tour.

We have visited Kauai for a number of years but this was our first flight around the island - why did we wait so long! This was without a doubt one of the best tours that we have taken anywhere in the world. From the initial booking through check-in, the flight itself and the end of the tour everyone from the owners, Ellen and Bruce, through to our pilot Josh was friendly, informative and professional. The plane with individual headsets and communication between the passengers and with Josh was quiet and comfortable, and the views, including the Canyon, Hanalei Bay,  the whales and sharks below, and much more were spectacular. Josh was a great pilot, very informative and had a great sense of humour. As others have mentioned, the plane is equipped with multiple go-pro cameras and the extra $50 for the video of the flight enabled me to focus on the views without having to worry all the time about taking pictures - it was available for download when we arrived home 2 days later and was well worth it. The whole experience was great value for money!

review_title: Great way to see the parks
review_text: We took the morning flight to see Canyonland and Arches National Parks.  It was great    We we’re saying “wow” the whole trip.   Our pilot was James and he was courteous and even with a windy day kept the flight very smooth.  He showed us great views of Needles, Maze, and the river confluence.  He would tip the wings so we would get a perfect view. I would highly recommend and ask for James to be your pilot.

So I'm not a fan of small airplanes, and had some trepidation about doing this.  But Eric, our pilot, was terrific.  Never took us into bumpy air, and kept up a dialog laced with humor and sightseeing facts.  It was easy making (email) arrangements and appointments, all the staff were friendly, they picked us up near our cruise ship, and returned us when the tour was over.  I was really happy I did this.  Also, I know helicopters are popular, and each to his own, but this fixed wing airplane was way smoother than bouncing around in a helicopter.  I felt safe, and enjoyed the entire flight, in no small part because of Eric.

The entire staff was incredible! Aaron made the flight alot of fun. Got good pictures of whales on the Hana side of the island. The scenery was amazing on a beautiful day. What a way to wrap up a trip to Maui. Will definitely do this again

We did this halfway through our vacation and it was great. Husband keeps commenting about seeing some of the sights we'd already been to but from a different angle, just incredible. Eric, the pilot, was quite entertaining.
We have done helicopter tours before and chose the biplane as something different. Really enjoyed the smooth ride and open air cockpit.

WOW! I wish I could give this tour more stars! Our pilot Josh was outstanding! Between the incredible views, smooth flying and knowledge of the island, this is easily one of the best tours on the island. They fly over sights and views which are not accessible any other way. Staff were really accommodating and the grounds staff did an excellent job. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this tour AND requesting Josh as your pilot!

I was lucky to fly with only two others in a small plane piloted by Doug. He gave us an excellent description of what to expect at each point in the flight. There were some clouds in front of Denali, but we got a partial view. We saw glaciers, canyons and stunning rock formations. The pilot enjoyed it as much as we did. I worked with the staff for several days off rescheduling for weather and always appreciated having the option of a full refund. I recommend K2 flights.

This trip was everything that I expected. At the start, the welcoming " ground crew" was very informative courteous and efficient.  The flight was beautiful.  We saw things so much more clearly than we could have from the ground, especially the Waiimea Canyon.  The pilot eas very informative and entertaining ( flew well too)

review_title: Grand Canyon Deluxe South Rim Tour was amaaaaazing!!
review_text:
Short review: 
DO IT!!!!  Westwind Air Service ROCKS!

Long review:
Why did we take this tour - We opted to do this tour because we were staying in Phoenix, and didn't want to spend 8 hours alone just driving to/from the Canyon.  So chose to cut our travel time down by 75% and fly!  We also wanted the experience of walking in the Canyon, as well as flying over it and getting in some other sights along the way.

Transport - We were picked up and dropped off at our hotel in downtown Phoenix in a timely manner.  Vehicle was a big and roomy Yukon.

Airport office - Westwind makes sure you're good to go on snacks.  Pretty much anything you could want they have.  And even their bathroom is fully stocked for the ladies.  

Staff - Pleasant, knowledgable, and incredibly friendly!!  

Plane - Roomy, safe, well appointed.  I believe we were in one of their Cessna 207's.  Prior to boarding, each of the couples (there were 3 of us, so a group of 6 total) were able to take our own photos in front of the plane.  The tour company takes a pic, and also took cell phone pics for us too.

Departure Flight - Flight comes with a pre-recorded (but nice!) narrated tour you listen to both to/from the Canyon.  Every now and then the pilot would voiceover and ask how we all were doing.

Tour - Landed in Grand Canyon Airport and were transported by Pink Jeep Tours.  Made three photo stops throughout the Canyon.  Driver was very knowledgeable and friendly as well.  The views were breathtaking and well worth the trip.  We stopped at a hotel/cottage that had another viewpoint of the Canyon and ate our box lunches. Sandwiches, chips, cookies, granola bar, apple, water.  Could have got other nibbles and visited gift shops but opted to eat box lunch and relax.  A surprise, we got a Grand Canyon DVD from Pink Jeep, wasn't expecting that!

Return flight - We took an aerial tour of the Canyon (note, I think this would have happened on the departure, but was a bit cloudy so we did it on the return).  The aerial tour was the money shot in my opinion. Once in a lifetime, truly.  How many ppl do you know that have gone to the Canyon?  Now...how many do you know that have flown over it for  20+min?  

Like I said DO IT!!! :-)

We took the grand tour around Denali and it was totally awesome as heck!!!  Very cool!!  Tour was very in depth and we got to circle around Denali.  We were not able to land on the Glacier, but that was ok.  The views were phenomenal.

This was an amazing experience! Eric made sure we were comfortable and made the “co-pilot” experience a lot of fun. He made sure he saw all the sights through the ride and had good picture moments. Would highly recommend it!

My husband and I took the Mountain Voyager with Glacier landing. Daniel, pilot, was extremely knowledgeable about the area, identifying the various mountains and geography.  We were there on a perfect blue bird day and were able to clearly see Mount Denali. Adding the glacier landing made this an exceptional experience. We had a limited amount of time so we wouldn't have gotten to Denali National Park without the  glacier landing. We got so close to the mountain and were able to check the box on another National Park. Highly recommend!

review_title: Spectacular way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: How do you beat your 12 year old expressing his thoughts," This was the best vacation of my entire life. It was amazing." That was all of our thoughts after taking the helicopter ride with Nate over the Grand Canyon on the Maverick helicopter. Top notch people at the counter, great pilot who was knowledgeable but gave us time to talk with each other and just take in the incredible view, and feeling very safe while in the air. I would recommend the Maverick helicopter tours to everyone.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: Thanks Capt Josh for a wonderful flight.  We had a private charter for 4.  Weather was perfect for a 230pm flight.  Saw the island from a completely different perspective.  We felt much safer in a plane than in a helicopter, and more affordable.  We have so many awesome photos and a video too.  Staff and service is excellent and personable.  Must do!!!

We took the Bi-Plane tour on May 24 and could not recommend it more. The staff was all great, and since I am a  Flight Instructor in California I can say our pilot Harry was outstanding. Informative, safe, and very knowledgeable of his plane and the the tour. Great commentary during the flight about all that you would never see by road. The plane was built in 2002 as a copy of the original ones and is very well cared for. You can tell that Harry loves his job and his plane. Fly with them anytime and enjoy the experience.

This is a bucket lister for sure. We called one day ahead and made the reservation with ease. I must say the young men who answered the phone had some of the nicest manners I have heard in a while.  The reservation was easy, and although they couldn't provide transport to the airport, we got a cab through the front desk at the Maswik. It was 27 bucks each way for 4 adults to be driven out of the park and into the little town of Tusayan where the airport was located.  The office is very nice with comfortable seating, gift shop, snack bar, clean restrooms.  They weigh you, and then you wait til your pilot comes and calls your group. We were a family of four, plus 2 singles, and the pilot, with one empty seat. They tell you where to sit according to weight distribution, so no fights about getting the front or back row.  Our pilot was BJ. and he was very clean cut and personable and prfessional. He also cracked a few jokes and posed for a pre flight pic. He tells you all the rules, is very calm and reassuring. This was my second heli flight so I knew what to expect, but nothing can prepare you for the moment the craft flies over the edge of the canyon. What a freakin thrill. We flew over the canyon for about half an hour before heading back over the rim and back to the airport. The whole time B.J. pointed out landmarks and answered questions and cracked jokes.  This trip provides you with unparalleled views. They also video tape the whole flight so you can enjoy it later without having to worry about a viewfinder. Highly recommend it if you can swing it moneywise, you will not be sorry.

review_title: Invest your Grand Canyon dollars here!!
review_text:
PLEASE do yourself a favor and book this experience. I'm traveling solo, but you may not get seated w your partner on the helicopter, as everyone is distributed by weight. I took the advice of other reviews and booked a time earlier in the day, for the clearest views. I was inspired and excited and not gonna lie, a bit weepy but in the best of ways and I held it together on the outside. 
Everyone at Maverick was professional and friendly and made this whole experience a joy. Our pilot was Forrest, and he was an amazing host and guide.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: The flight was an excellent way to see all parts of the island, especially the NaPali coast. Our pilot (Paul) made sure everyone could see the sites regardless on which side of the plane you were on.  He was funny and seemed very knowledgeable about the island. The flight was smooth and fun. We liked that it's an eco-friendly way to see the island as well! Would definitely recommend this tour.
Must Do. Add to your bucket list. It was the most memorable adventure on our trip and we had many to choose from.

My wife and I recently went on this tour, and we were blown away by how amazing it was! From the moment we arrived we knew we made the right choice with Maverick. The check-in process was quick and easy, and we were on our way in no time. Of all of the stops we made driving on the Road to Hana, this helicopter trip was the most memorable by far. Our pilot Felix was incredible and expertly put down the helicopter in the middle of the jungle. Once landed, he provided us with fresh fruit and champagne as we explored the lush environment. This moment itself made the trip worthwhile, let alone the incredible views and insightful commentary he provided. We will definitely be going on this trip again!!
Was an amazing tour!! We live in the city and it was such a fun way to see it from another angle!! The captain was great and informative and the plane was so so cool. Would definitely recommend this!

review_title: Right side rewards, left side regrets.
review_text: This sightseeing flight offered some beautiful views, but I found the experience heavily favored passengers on the right side of the aircraft. As a left-side passenger, my view was primarily of the shoreline, and I missed out on many of the central island's key attractions like the mountains, canyons, and waterfalls. To maximize your experience, I'd strongly recommend requesting a right-side seat. Additionally, strategically maneuvering the aircraft to provide brief, alternating views of key landmarks for both sides of the plane could help ensure a more equitable experience for all passengers.

A colleague said it was worth the money to do a flight-seeing tour around Denali and he was right. Staff was friendly and knowledgeable. Beautiful views of the mountain that you cannot get from the ground.

Bruce and Ellen are warm and welcoming!  Bruce begins the plane ride with an interesting check-off list for the plane which simply educates the passengers about the plane and sets the stage for an amazing ride over the island of Kauai.  My 10 year old daughter and I had a fabulous experience and felt very safe, and Bruce's commentary on the island was enlightening.  The plane ride was quiet (Bruce has top-of-the-line headsets which we used to communicate with) and the plane ride was very smooth.  Mahalo to Wings over Kauai for adding to our love of this island!  Gina and Sophia, Aloha from the Garden State to the Garden Island!

No sé cuál será tu presupuesto de viaje al cañón del ColorDo pero la experiencia de ver el Parque Nacional desde el aire no tiene comparación con cualquier otra vista del cañón . Te recomiendo esta compañía para esta experiencia pues son muy atentos y profesionales. El piloto será quien te reciba en el hall y será también quien te dé todas las explicaciones en el aire. Hay cuatro asientos detrás y dos delante. Obviamente la experiencia no tiene nada que es si vas en el centro o delante por lo que nosotros pedimos los de delante para nuestras parejas y nos los concedieron aunque la colocación la hacen por peso. Cuando termines el tour el piloto te hace fotos si se lo pides. Una gran experiencia!

This was supposed to be the "cherry on top" for our family Alaska trip, since our daughter is a mountain girl and pilot. Due to weather, we weren't able to fly as high as planned, and fresh snow prevented landing/walking on glacier. (Sad!) 
Regardless, it was INCREDIBLE!!!! THE FOOTHILLS ALONE WERE MAGNIFICENT!! 
Pilot let our pilot girl be "co-pilot" (no controls, of course!) 
Great experience! Courteous, helpful staff. Half refund since couldn't do what booked. Great communication from 6 months out til trip.
Absolutely magnificent tour.  Wonderful staff.  Helpful pilots.  When you have a snowball fight on a glacier, what's not to like?

Hands down a must. I surprised my bf on our vay cay to Seattle was def worth the 3 hr drive. Davis was so amazing! He took some great photos of us before the flight. The views were amazing and he was so informative. I’ve never seen my bf so happy!! Daniel was amazing as well.

Our Family's Experience With Air Ventures Hawaii, Was Completely "Breathtaking", As Well As "Unforgettable".... My husband and two daughters were completely captivated by all the Beauty that was experienced from the air...  Paul, was an "Amazing" pilot and he took us on quite an Adventure!!!  The Island is so beautiful by land travel, but it's absolutely "Exquisite" by air...  If you get the chance to take this Air Adventure, Take It....!!!!  We'll be back next year as well, and the year after that, and the year after that and........etc.!!!

review_title: fantastic airplane tour of Kaua'i Very reasonable rates and friendly people.
review_text: Highy recommend this trip.Tthe pilot Dr. Bruce was also most informative about the sites, anecdotes and history. Knew good places to visit or to eat at. Great time! Don't miss it.

We can’t say enough about Miami Seaplane.  It was wonderful from start to finish. We felt safe and more than that our pilot Tony and boat captain Yanni were both delightful. They were incredibly sweet with our young children as well. We would definitely do this again and it was a memorable adventure !!
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_text: This was a most rewarding experience, of course, the weather was perfect. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and pointed out the sights we were seeing as well as informative on the Alaskan weather, the climate, the rights of the people on settling there and etc. A great flight, smooth on takeoff and landing. The plane performed wonderfully. I would recommend this adventure to anyone visiting the Talkeetna area.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is highly recommended - i have flow the Denali trip with Glacier landing several times and my confidence in TAT improves with each trip - - they very professional, personal and extremely knowledgeable about the area in which they fly.
Laura was a great guide and pilot, and the views were outstanding!  Our 13 year old said this was the highlight of the trip!  Thank you Laura for a great ride!

I won't write too much as I don't wish to spoil your enjoyment.

All I will say is this is a MUST, if you wish to see the Grand Canyon from a birds eye view with a friendly, knowledgable pilot don't think about the price and go ahead and book.

This is an experience I will treasure for life

We did the Grand Denali + Glacier landing tour. This is a MUST DO if you want to see Mt. Denali. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly. Our pilot was super sweet and did a great job of explaining things during the flight and giving ample opportunities for photos in the air. We also did the glacier landing, which was well worth the extra cost. This was a highlight of our trip to Alaska! Highly recommended!

review_title: Highlight of our trip to AK
review_text: This is the first time I have flown in a small airplane so was a little hesitant.  I should not have been as the flight was excellent and I never once felt scared.  I thought the flight might be turbulent but it wasn't.  Our pilot was Alex and he was calm, cool and collect during our 1 1/2 hour flight with glacier landing.  He advised us what we were seeing every step of the way and his landing were terrific. My husband and I were so glad we took this flight and chose Talkeetna Air Taxi...Outstanding.
This was an amazing experience with a great pilot. It is the only plane on the island with a window that opens to take photos.  It was my favorite part of the trip!

This was a surprise birthday present for my daughter and it was a massive hit. Although one couple on the flight tried to ruin it for everyone by being difficult my amazing daughter stepped to the front and dealt with the situation.
Well, after that little hiccup it was a great flight over the mountains and lakes and actually landed on one lake for a short stop.
Totally recommend as a must do on the bucket list, a little expensive but hey you can't take it with you so go for it.

review_title: By far the best option in Portland
review_text: Envi was a breath of fresh air. My husband and I were originally looking at going on a helicopter tour from downtown Portland from another company but after bad experiences with customer service we found Envi and decided to see if it would be any different and it was amazing. They were beyond helpful the prices were way more affordable and the experience was longer. Much better value for your money! Our pilot was so nice and really good at what he did. We can’t recommend Envi more. 10/10 all the way and so much fun.

Yeah a glacier landing at 400 bucks is an expensive way to spend two hours.
But the experience was beyond description and our pilot was highly skilled.  Ask for the military discount.  Make sure to bring your National Park pass to save a few dollars as well.
This is a must do while on Kauai! Staff is fantastic!  So amazing to see this beautiful island from the air.

We booked a tour very last minute because it was something we've never experienced and we were absolutely blown away! Our pilot Ray was wonderful. Great pilot, and even better person. I don't think the trip would have been quite the same without him. He pointed out so many little details we wouldn't have noticed otherwise. Every minute of our tour was a delight. 100% recommend!

Selected "Grand Canyon Connoisseur" tour after seeing the great reviews here and was really looking forward to it. 

Got off to a bad start as we had to wait an hour for the plane which was due to fly 9.15am (for the south rim) and there were no information/explanation whatsoever for the delay. Then the headphones on the plane was faulty. 

Next, we were grouped together with a Japanese tour group, with a scenic airlines guide who appeared to be dedicated to them. From the minute we landed in Grand Canyon, there were no instructions on where to head to and we had to find our own way and ask around. On the coach rides, other than a short introduction from the other English speaking guide, the Japanese guide hogged the microphone and everything conversed during the rides were in Japanese language. This was despite there were other English speaking people on the tour, who obviously doesn't understand Japanese.

For each of the 2 stops, 50 minutes were given for us to walk around. The tour ended around 2pm and then AGAIN, another long 50 minutes wait for the return flight with no information on delay. Would have thought there would be better planning and more seamless transfers for an established tour. 

Though the views of the Grand Canyon were fantastic, this tour really marred the whole experience.

With my over 50 years of flying, I can easily say this was a great flight!  Our pilot, Dennis Erb, was enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and above all, an outstanding and professional aviator...  Thank you Dennis...

Our family flew with Friday Harbor Seaplanes from Renton/Seattle to and from San Juan Island. The planes are beautifully maintained and the pilots we had were top notch.  This was my first seaplane flight and I was amazed by the smooth takeoff/landing (which makes sense because water is a bit more forgiving upon landing than a runway) as well as the smooth ride. 

My kids LOVED the experience; they were initially pretty nervous about flying in such a small plane but ended up completely loving the entire experience (including their use of the headsets over a radio channel).  My wife also was a big fan.  We all enjoyed the gorgeous views as we flew through the San Juan archipelago. 

Shane, the owner, is clearly passionate about what he does. We had a flight delay coming out of Chicago and really appreciated that Shane did what he could to help us get to San Juan Island given our late arrival.

Thank you Kevin for such a wonderful flight around Kauai. We saw everything from the Na Pali Coast, Wailea canyon, beaches, waterfalls, volcanic remains. Such a great way to see the island. We have travelled on the island for 10 days and the trip put everything in perspective and allowed us to see the many bits you cannot get too.
Thank you to Jill and Kaycee with the booking.
This is a must do for anyone going to Denali.  You see Mt. McKinley from so close, and see so many glaciers.  The views are breathtaking.  The glacier landing is definitely worth it!

Went with Westwind on a tour over the Grand Canyon to Monument Valley, with an overflight and ground tour with a very knowledgeable guide, then back in the plane for a flight over Lake Powell, Horseshoe bend and the Grand Canyon again.

It was absolutely amazing - the best way to see Arizona and all the amazing different landscapes is from the air! 

Westwind did an really really great job. From booking, to checking in to their aircraft - everything was high quality and they really looked after us and made the trip even more enjoyable. The small touches like the nice background music on the flight, the leather seats and being greeted by the ground staff at the gate with big smiles when we got back all made the difference too and made me feel really comfortable and impressed with the company and its service. Its also very good value for what you get - 3 of the most beautiful parts of the country right together, that would otherwise take you days and a lot of hassle to see any other way.

Highly recommended - if you're in the Grand Canyon or Arizona this tour is really amazing, the Grand Canyon is good on its own too, but if you have an extra couple of hours, see the other just as amazing sights which are right close by!

review_title: One of the best choices we made on our vacation...
review_text:
While on our vacation is Kauai, we decided to take in a few of the activities offered around the island.  We will never regret our decision to take a flight with Air Ventures.  When they say you have not seen Kauai unless you've seen it by air, they are %100 correct.
It was awesome!  The staff was very polite and very knowledgeable of the history of the island.  I'm glad that we decided on this trip rather than 3-4 seperate outings as we saw it all!  We will be taking this one again when we return to Kauai!  Not to mention the incredible pictures...

We went on a family trip to Grand Canyon in April and took the Canyon Spirit Tour with Maverick. It's a lot of money and I did wonder whether it would be worth it but we had a fantastic time, and would thoroughly recommend it to anyone. Maverick is a very slick and efficient operation with modern helicopters in pristine condition and our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. One small thing to be aware of is that their "Grand Canyon South Rim terminal" isn't actually at the South Rim but at Tusayan a few miles south. Not a big deal, but Maverick seem to be a bit shy about their actual location!
We had a very unique experience. Erik was an awesome pilot and made the experience special. I loved being able to see the island in the sky!!!
Amazing aerial experience to get all of Kauais beauty in 1 hour. May not go low as helicopters, but still stunning views! Our pilot Justin was amazing at explaining all geographies and details too!

review_title: Great flight and excellent pilot! A must to do when in Kauai
review_text: Captain Marcus was an excellent pilot and tour guide. My family and I enjoyed the trip very much! Marcus was very kind to offer suggestions on things to do to make my son feel better when he got a little airsick. A great way to see the beautiful Garden Isle and a must-do activity to orient yourself to the things you may want to do and see when you're there.

I arranged for seven of us to go on a mountain view flight with glacier landing.  From the moment we arrived all throughout the process we had such a tremendous experience. Our pilot was knowledgeable, an excellent flight engineer, and had beautiful take-offs and landings. His narration and knowledge of the local area was superior. We had beautiful skies and were able to see all of the base camps for the climbers on Denali.  We were able to view several different approaches and see climbers on the side of Denali on the day we went. Our Glazier landing was absolutely superb. The very inviting individuals that work there offered to shuttle us to a local restaurant when we were done.  That level of service Is not something seen frequently in my travel experience.  Each of us thought it was one of the greatest travel experiences we have ever had. We would recommend this company to anyone who wanted a glacier landing and intimate experience with the mountains.

user_location: El Cardoso de la Sierra, Spain
review_text: A great scenic air tour around Canyonlands. The best family experience before starting our visits to the parks. The six of us really enjoyed. Dave, the pilot, explained every corner. Thanks Dave!

Oh my gosh!  Highlight of our trip.  We did the McKinley base camp flight and it was breathtaking, inspirational, beautiful flight.  We kep going back and forth over whether we should pay the extra for the glacier landing.  SO GLAD WE DID!  Best part of the flight! Landed at a location with magnificent views of McKinley.  We lucked out and had a beautiful, clear day.  Couldn't have been better!
So many pictures! They do not capture the entire experience. The music they played while going over the Grand Canyon added more excitement.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: I definitely recommend seeing the Grand Canyon by air on your first visit. We did this first when we arrived. Incredible views and well-priced for a 45 minute rim to rim your. Great value!

I think sometimes an experience like this is left for a "special occasion' or with a "special person".  I'm here to tell you life happens and those "special occasions and people" most often happen when you aren't planning them.  If you're thinking maybe, just do it.  You won't be disappointed.  Loved the pilot and how he shared his knowledge of the Bay Area with both its history and his personal experience intertwined.  I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: A perfect flight, must to do in Portland
review_text: We made Quick sand triangle at 8 pm. We had beautiful light. Flight was very nice. The pilote is very good. We landed with wind, but He made a very smooth landing !!!
Amazing time. Couldn’t believe the views. Never seen anything like this. Did this trip with some friends and would highly recommend

review_title: A highlight of our stay in Kauai
review_text: My husband and I flied with Bruce with Cessna, it was an amazing experience. Not only the astonishing bird view of Kauai island but also the flying experience Wings Over Kauai has brought us. From the first step into the site, a friendly welcome from Ellen and professional briefing from Sherry made us feel very comfortable. And the pilot also the owner Bruce was quite informative, he introduced to us different valleys, beaches, plants and fairy tales as well:):) Importantly during a short bumpy his confidence and professional skill conveyed us confidence and safty. We thank Ellen, Sherry and Bruce for bringing us this wonderful fly experience!
Great service. Narration along the way there. None on the way back which was good, at the end of the day have info overload.
It was a beautiful way to see Kauai!  Our pilot was quiet but the views spectacular!  I appreciated that everyone had a window seat and the plane was turned so both sides saw each view.

review_title: One of the best experiences in Alaska
review_text: This was our 2nd time in Ketchikan but we had never done any Sea plane trips that local companies advertised, however this time we decided to do it. We chose SeaWind Aviations bear trip. We had just came off the cruise and waited patiently for a Mini bus to pick us up. We got in the Mini bus and were greeted by a very pleasant local lady. It was about a 10 minute drive from the dock to where we were departing to see the bears. The Check in building was small and cosy there were to 2 sofas and an area in the back were you could keep large bulky bags because they were not allowed on the aircraft. We flew in a de havilland Beaver flown by a former carrier pilot Fred. It was a short but memorable flight lasting about 20 minutes. Once we landed our guide (Who was hilarious) asked us to follow him into the forest. I advise everyone to wear appropriate shoes and bring mosquito spray. He took us through the Forrest to a viewing platform were we saw the beautiful black bears and Bald eagles. it was an amazing experience and a must do.

I can't say enough good things about this experience. The flight around Denali was outstanding. The views were incredible. The glacier landing was spectacular. I would highly recommend adding the glacier landing to your flight, you won't regret it. Thank you K2 for such a wonderful experience and a lifetime of memories made.

O passeio foi surpreendente! Sobrevoar aquelas montanhas de gelo é uma visão fantástica e emocionante. Até esquecemos que no aviãozinho só cabiam 6 pessoas! O pouso sobre a geleira foi sensacional e andar sobre ela deu a real dimensão daquela grandiosidade de gelo. Recomendo muito!

This was our first time to take a private tour and it was an amazing experience! We enjoyed the view, the owner and pilot were very friendly/hospital and their prices are very reasonable. Definitely doing this again and would highly recommend it
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: Great guide/pilot.  We left and toured Kauai for over 1.5 hours with literally birds' eye view of the great sites of Kauai.  Water fall, coast line, historical tid bits and beautiful geography.  Very very smooth plane ride and trip of a life time.  Thank you air ventures!

The Willow area was going through severe wildfires which fortunately were under control. People lost homes so I cannot complain that the smoke haze was still in air.  Matt got us above the smoke level at 7000 feet and we had a great view and amazing trip.  Talkeetna cannot guarantee your view but will make sure you have the best possible and safest experience.

review_title: An Amazing Experience. Well worth the purchase.
review_text:
This was always going to rate highly for me. I love flying, I love nature, so I had high expectations. All of them were met and exceeded. 

Rivers, the pilot, was a professional through and through. It was a beautiful smooth ride, with a great narration of the canyon.  His music choices perfectly complimented the trip as well. 

The staff from Maverick at the airport were amazing too. Super friendly and helpful, and added greatly to the pleasant experience. 

I will, without any hesitation, recommend all family and friends to use Maverick Helicopters from here on. 

Thanks for a great flight.

review_title: Your Kauai trip is not complete without Wings!
review_text: Our one-hour tour with bruce was the highlight of our visit to beautiful Kauai. The flight was very smooth, narrated with knowledge, humor, and personality, and the views were breathtaking. Don't jam yourself into a pricey helicopter ride...try Wings Over Kauai instead. Bruce and Ellen are just fabulous and the price is definitely right! We'd rate them as "super-excellent!" Phil & Vicki

review_title: Phenomenal experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: After another flightseeing tour company had to cancel at the last minute due to a sick pilot, Talkeetna Air Taxi came to the rescue. Their staff answered all our questions and got us scheduled onto one of their flights with minimal effort on our part. Pilot Clay did a fantastic job, making us feel safe and well-informed at all times. The flight itself was incomparable and the glacier landing is an absolute must-do!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text:
Wings Over Kauai Tours was one of the highlights of our Kauai stay.  Bruce and Ellen were thoughtful and informative.  Their attention to details really shows.  The flight was spectacular.
