When it was all over we felt we had friends we have known forever.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen for letting this old rusty pilot fly your beautiful plane and the Bose headsets were the icing on the cake.

Thanks again for making our stay more memorable.

Mike and Evelyn Parson
Portland Or

An amazing experience equal to helicopter at half the price. Pilot took us through 
Canyon and Coast and around the island. It was a remarkable experience

My wife and I took up Captain Bruce's personalized tour of Kauai in his Cessna. His daughter, Mary, was wonderfully kind to us when we checked in. Captain Bruce was friendly and warm towards us, as well as funny! I was glued to my camera, photographing everything on the island. We wanted a personalized tour of the island from above, and that's exactly what we got. I highly recommend this to anyone who's making a visit to Kauai. You cannot leave the island without doing this.

A little shutterbugging note, for those interested in photos, you will be well served to sit in the back so the strut isn't in your view. They do have another, larger plane that may offer larger fields of view.

review_title: Wonderful flight along the coast to Hana
review_text: To see the waterfalls, the green and lush Forrest’s, the breaking waves up close from a birds eyes view, flying along Maui’s coast, touching down in Hana, circling back over the Red Sand beach, just an unforgettable experience I can recommend to anyone. Thank you Eric for this wonderful flight.

We were in Kauai the last week of September.  It just took me a while to do this review.  The day after we arrived we were on the Wings Over Kauai tour.  It was great.  Never having been here, it was nice to get an aerial view of the island.  From this, we were able to plan what we wanted to see for the week that we were here.  Josh was our pilot and guide.  He had loads of information about the island and he was a lot of fun.  We had done the helicopter tour on the Big Island 3 years ago so we knew we wanted to try something different on Kauai.  It was the best hour tour we had.  There was only one other couple on the plane so it really felt like we had the plane to ourselves.  I highly recommend this tour.

We chose Air Ventures to see the island of Kauai and it was wonderful!  The people were friendly and so helpful too! The owners & pilot were so nice & knowledgeable!  This is a one of the best ways to see the island, since most of it you can't reach by car.
It was so much cheaper than a Helicopter too! So glad we took this tour is was amazing!
If you have a gopro bring it!

What an amazing experience.  Not something I will probably ever get the chance to do again, so highly recommend this if you are looking to experience Maui from a different point of view.  The waters and colours of blue and the scenic landscapes were breath-taking.  Eric, our pilot, ensured that we felt comfortable and at ease the whole flight, and was very knowledge throughout about the island of Maui.  He even let me take control for ten mins or so.  Cannot recommend this enough.

review_title: Great Experience with Grand Canyon and pilot
review_text: Awesome way to experience the true size and beauty of the Grand Canyon. Our pilot James is an extremely experienced veteran with a great personality and sence of humor. Very knowledgeable about canyon details. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone...

review_text: giornata perfetta, zero nuvole, temperatura 30-31 gradi Celsius. volo perfetto. panorama spettacolare. tutto come nelle attese. suggerito !
Very enjoyable and informative flight. Our pilot was excellent and the trip was amazing to see how vast the Grand Canyon is.
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_text: My husband and I did the flight and hike adventure with K2 as part of our honeymoon. We had an amazing time! We chose to meet at the office, but were offered a pickup at our lodge. We were weighed in and our hiking guide met us early. We were then transported to Fish Lake where we met our pilot Brian and very well maintained Beaver float plane. We were blessed with a post card perfect, crystal clear day. We had an amazing flight out to Backside Lake. During the flight, our pilot pointed out many areas of interest and was knowledgeable. His landing on the lake was the smoothest landing I have ever experienced. Once we landed, our hiking guide led us on an amazing hike around the lake. Our flight back was just as incredible and we were able to spot several moose from the air. Our landing was again as smooth as could be. This was our favorite Alaskan adventure to date! It is worth every penny!!
This was a truly amazing experience. Eric not only was a great pilot, he was clearly passionate about his island, a great narrator, and thoughtful that each passenger had amazing views of Kauai.

What an incredible experience.  The entire tour looked like things you only see in magazines.  Matt was our pilot- he was super knowledgeable, friendly and safe.  It was breathtakingly beautiful to see those huge mountains up close.  Hard to imagine people rock climb and hike those mountains.

review_title: Jaw-dropping visual delight! Safe, calm and professional experience, all at half the price of a helicopter ride!
review_text:
As a private pilot myself, I can testify that Bruce and Ellen provide an A-grade experience, with a strong foundation in safety and proper aviation protocols. 

Bruce gave us a detailed flight briefing for the Australian-made AirVan, which is a robust and spacious airplane. After a smooth takeoff, helped by a headwind, he took us on a lovely flight around Kuaui covering all the high points of this jewel of an island. 

We flew over the Pacific Ocean alongside the beautiful beaches of South Kuaui then turned inland to see the awesomeness of the Waimea Canyon. Then we were over the NāPali coast on the north side, appreciating the amazing rock formations winding down like spines into the ocean. After that, we turned inland again, this time to the south, and made our way back to Lihue just above the tall peaks of the highlands. 

All in all, an excellent experience, made sweeter by the knowledge that this trip was less than half the cost of a similar helicopter excursion!

Thanks Bruce and Ellen for a great time, and also for the amazing fruit :-)!

Only in America, they let a sea plane start and land among the speedboats. We came by boat, tied it to one of the moorings in the bay close to the planes beach (there is no boat dock available) and our pilot picked us up at our boat, you can't beat that!! 

We had a lot of luck and saw a lot of marine live. If everybody here would do their job with same enthusiasm as our pilot did his, this country would be in no crisis !!!!

Great experience!

Thanks Bernd
Ray is a great pilot that showed us lots of waterfalls and good commentary. It was a good ride. We thoroughly enjoyed the sites he flew over.

This was one of the most beautiful tours we have taken in our 70+ years. I would highly recommend taking a helicopter and to go with the Maverick helicopter Co. You will not get better views anywhere of the Canyon and the picture opportunities do not stop. You will also fly over the Hoover Dam and Lake Mead. Trip is approximately 4 hrs. from your hotel and back to your hotel. the tour itself approximately 21/2 hours. It includes a landing in the canyon with a lite brunch .  The flight we took was from 8:00 AM to 12;00 pm. The helicopter held six of us, my wife and i and a family of two adults and 2 teen age daughters from Australia. We all loved the trip and were glad we decided to see canyon in this manner.,

review_title: Gorgeous views! A must see way to see the island
review_text: Breathtaking views and the pillow was very knowledgeable. Worth every penny. Perfect way to see the entire island

The experience is really great. Everything is well organized and the pilot and helicopter are great.

45 minutes go by quickly as takeoff and landing are also included.

review_text: We were unlucky enough to fly on a day when the cloud ceiling was really low. The flight people were awesome in their response. They offered a full refund (which we declined), they gave us an extended flight to try to find the best glacier views, and offered a partial refund to those people who had booked a glacier landing.

I can't say enough about this amazing flight seeing experience. The staff at K2 were wonderful, they did their best to manage expectations regarding the weather and possibility of a glacier landing and were very helpful in making sure all passengers were ready to go and comfortable (even let some of us borrow sunglasses!). Our pilot was very safety-minded and knowledgeable. This flight is so much more than seeing Denali, it's about being amidst the huge, wild, jagged mountains that surround it. Puffy clouds only made it all the more dramatic. Our glacier landing was such fun, and although we couldn't spend too much time on the glacier itself due to flight traffic, it was still such an adventure. You don't want to miss out on this experience, so plan some flexibility in your schedule in case your scheduled flight is delayed for weather.

review_title: Fantastic views over San Francisco Harbour
review_text: Very easy to book online, though when I booked I didn't realise that the flight was from Sausalito. A very friendly organisation - I messed up the booking and they rearranged without a murmur. Though a transfer was available from Pier 39 San Francisco, we caught the Ferry to Sausaliti earlier in the day, had a wander and lunch before catching an Uber to the Seaplane base (around $6). The flight was at 3.15 and lasted over 1/2 hour, the pilot was a character and the views brilliant. We were on a small de Havilland Canada plane in pretty much empty air space. Great photos, great day (though the Golden Gate Bridge was partly covered in cloud).

Literally the best!!! Was here on a family vacation and this was the main event. Well worth it! Would recommend to anyone visiting Maui. I’m sensitive to motion sickness and this ride didn’t effect me at all. Smooth flying and easy to enjoy.

review_title: Flight to Grand Canyon and hike
review_text: The company was professional, courteous, and the entire day was so much fun! We walked in and immediately they explained the itinerary, introduced us to the pilot and guide, presented us with Panera lunches, and answered all questions. We flew over and learned about places like Flagstaff and Sedona, and landed near the Grand Canyon. There, a van took us to the place we would hike. All 6 of my family members enjoyed the day immensely and we were all so pleased with the company!! I wish I could remember our guides name, she was great!
The weather was perfect, and the views were outstanding. The pilot was great ! She was well informed and funny.

We opted for this small plane tour rather than a helicopter, partly because it was much more economical, and also because we didn't want to get stuck in a helicopter seat with a lousy view, which can happen.  We weren't disappointed. Bruce took us all around the island, offering interesting tidbits of history and trivia, and the views were fantastic. My husband had a little flying experience and got to help with the take off and fly a little bit too, which thrilled him.  We even got a short video included as a memento of the flight. We've never done the copter tour, so I can't compare, but I can't imagine that it would have been any better, just different, and much more expensive.

we arrived to find out the the weather would not permit the plane to do the glacier landing that we had planned we were offered a sight seeing tour at a discounted rate or a full refund, no problems, then even after we deceided not to go these guys gave us a ride to our next destination for no charge!! i was impressed

review_title: Wow! The best views of the Canyon!
review_text:
We had an awesome ride on a Maverick Helicopter with our pilot Todd! 
It was a beautiful, calm day and the views were spectacular! It was well worth the price for the two of us! 
Although the copter could seat 6, there were only 4 of us so each person had a window view!

review_title: Hightlight of the trip to Moab!
review_text: I am so happy that I went with Redtail Air Adventures for my unforgettable experience in Moab! The pilot pointed out the popular places at each National Park and we found out some great local information about the area. Moab has so much history and is breathtaking! I definitely recommend choosing Redtail Air, it’s an experience I will never forget!

review_title: A unique way to see Kauai
review_text: We organised a one day fly in/ out trip to Kauai from Honolulu and Wings Over Kauai helped make it an unforgettable experience. The flight covered some amazing landscapes, visibility form the plane was excellent, and the whole experience was very professionally managed. Everybody had a window seat, and the flight was a generous 65 minutes.

Flight was scheduled for 1pm and we didn’t leave the ground until 2:30. They were very nice overall but that was a long wait for something that we scheduled ahead of time. It would have been nice to know they were running behind before we got there so we could eat or go look around town before

review_title: Good airline to charter for your Grand Canyon float trip.
review_text: Our group (Tour West) chartered with Grand Canyon Airlines to fly our group from Boulder City to Marble Canyon for the put-in, and then we were picked up at the Bar Ten Ranch airstrip at the conclusion of our river trip.  Our group of 16 flew in a Twin Otter, and the flights were professionally operated by experienced pilots.  There was quite a bit of wind shear flying into Marble Canyon so we were diverted to Page to land on the larger strip.  The pilot landed the aircraft in a serious cross-wind but he landed the plane safely.  Our flights were also very scenic by the way!  We fly a lot in Alaska in some pretty marginal weather, and I would recommend this airline to anyone visiting the Grand Canyon.
Amazing. Flying on the seaplane was awesome. The pilot was awesome and very informative. Loved it!!! We flew from Seattle to Friday Harbor.
The glacier flight was fantastic and our pilot Stan was funny and informative. Great service from beginning to end. A flight experience worth every penny!

We took a flight seeing excursion with K2 as part of a tour so all the arrangements were made for us except for the weather, of course.  Poor weather conditions around Denali made it impossible for us to see "the great one" but K2 came up with a flight plan that included extensive aerial views of the fascinating forest growth patterns interspersed with glacial river routes, moose, bear and homestead habitat, and we still got to see amazing glaciers in the Alaska range.  It was a smooth flight from start to finish and our pilot, Chip, was very knowledgeable about the flora, fauna, glaciers and the importance of aviation in Alaska history.  If we ever have the chance and the weather is right, we'll be flying with K2 to see Denali someday.

review_title: Maverick Helicopters Were great and  Honest, Tripadvisors not so much.
review_text: We booked the 45 minute flight, but all flights were cancelled at the last minute due to high winds. Maverick was very upfront about refunding our money on the spot, but could not since we booked through Tripadvisor ( who indicated no refunds for any reason).  There was no convenient way to even contact Tripadvisor.  Fortunately, Maverick persevered for us with Tripadvisor to get a refund.  We were still out about $30 for Tripadvisor fees, but did get $698 back.  No thanks to Tripadvisor, but due to the honest efforts by Maverick. I will think twice before ever using Tripadvisor again.

review_text: Oh my gosh this was seriously breath taking. Dress warm! The plane is chilly. The views are incredible. We did the glacier landing - HIGHLY recommend. There is nothing like it. The pilot was friendly and fun!

We purchased this ride for a friend. He can’t stop talking about it. Says it was the best thing in his life he has ever been able to do. A once in a lifetime event for him. He was impressed with the pilot and the overall experience from beginning to end.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: We flew from our adventure in Maze District back to Moab and oh my...what an awesome experience!! The plane picked us up at a landing strip in the middle of nowhere (Angel Point). The pilot was VERY kind and described the terrain the whole way back. This was my first flight in a small plane like that and I was thrilled!! The ride was smooth and the scenery beyond belief!! I was completely impressed!!

review_title: Grand views with an experienced team
review_text: I did the Grand Denali tour with TAT. Ground staff was very friendly and always helpful with coordinating the flight and making sure I'm well equipped for the glacier landing (provided goretex shoes). The pilot was fun and knowledgeable and let me sit next to him - this way I had an even more amazing view of the mountains.

I had an wonderful time and got to steer the plane for parts of the trip, including during takeoff! Steve was really amazing and I learned a lot. It was incredible to see many parts of Hawaii I would not have been able to see from the ground.
The weather was perfect for mountain viewing. The staff in the office assisted us very well. The pilot was great and very informative. He was even taking pictures!

It was the first trip to Alaska for my husband and me. We elected the option to fly over the three glaciers in order to get a close up look of the glaciers and surrounding mountains.  Patrick wash an excellent guide who made sure to make turns so that all passengers saw the views from all angles regardless of where you were seated.  He also provided several opportunities for close ups.  Highly recommend

Best way to end our vacation. A good way to enjoy the island from above, and a great way to see all the beautiful waterfalls and the gorgest rainbows. 
The pilot was excellent from beginning to end. He was very informative of all the island details. Tried his best to give us a smooth flight and he would let us know in advance were it would be bumpy.

We just returned home from Alaska. Sadly, it rained most of our 12 days but we still had a fabulous time. We were rescheduled 3 times for the K2 flight into the mountains and we actually thought it would not happened. On the day we left for home we were able to squeeze in this trip--the fog lifted and the sun came out for a short window of time. We had a fabulous flight. Got very close to the mountain. The people at K2 were fabulous; they did not leave us but kept coming back to give reports and encouragement. So glad it happened but if it hadn't, they promised a full refund. Glad we didn't get it! Thanks a bunch--a real highlight. (Phyllis from RI)

review_title: Even better than expected - and our expectations were high!
review_text: We had scheduled a glacier landing but the weather precluded that.  As a pilot myself, I completely understood and, of course, agreed with the decision.  Instead, our pilot took us flying over glaciers, in between rock walls, and over fascinating terrain.  In spite of the change in plans, we were delighted with the experience.  Our pilot was more than just a proficient aviator; he was a knowledgeable and delightful guide, continuously pointing out items of interest and lingering at interesting locations. We were fortunate enough to observe another airplane about a mile away in one of the valleys to give us a scale of reference; without anything of known size below, it is easy to underestimate the size of the vistas.  Bring a camera.  I did, but never got it out; I was too busy enjoying the experience.  If you are unsure about whether or not to book a flight, stop wondering - DO IT.  My wife, who is interested in geology, asked that I add exclamation points throughout this review.  I am collecting them all here - ! ! ! ! ! !

Our "air adventure" was nothing short of spectacular. Unfortunately, our original flight had to be rescheduled due to weather, but we were so glad it was. The company set up an early flight the following day with JT as our pilot. Our flight was smooth and the views were incredible. JT was very knowledgeable about the culture of Kauai and shared all kinds of knowledge during the flight. This was our first time to Kauai and this trip made our vacation unforgettable. We highly recommend Air Ventures. We would definitely do this again.

We were picked up at Bellagio hotel at 7am (beware it is at the parking downstairs), driven in a shuttle to the Maverick helicopter base in Las Vegas, and after a briefing we went aboard an EC-130 helicopter which seems to be made for sightseeing. We got into the helicopter half an hour after our arrival and flew over the  Hoover dam and several other places in the Grand Canyon. We landed and had a light brunch at mid journey at about 70 miles from the base, and then we returned back to the base by another path. There we could change place with the two passengers who had the front seats, and we changed another time after the refueling. Everybody (we were 6 passengers) could experience the front seats. We ended the tour with an overflight of the Las Vegas Strip. The pilot was very kind, he answered to all the silly questions we had with lots of patience. Around 12pm we were back at the Bellagio. We paid around $2100 for a family of 4 in August 2014. This tour deserves to be recommended. This was certainly the best part of our travel across the US.

We decided at the last minute to add a flightseeing trip around Mt McKinley and surrounding peaks. We were not disappointed. Had a fantastic weather day. There is no way to explain the immense beauty we saw on our flight. Talkeetna Air staff are great and, especially our pilot. He made sure everyone on the plane got an opportunity to see all the amazing sites and take photos. His narration throughout the flight was spot-on. Definitely the highlight of our Alaska trip. Take the glacier landing tour, if you can. It is a one-in-a-lifetime experience.

Amazing!!!
If you are in Kauai make sure you do this flight. We were going to do the helicopter but changed our mind because of the price. We are so glad we found Wings over Kauai, our pilot was so informative and we got the best views of the island, it was stunning!
Thank you Wings over Kauai for a great experience :)

The 4 of us did the private tour.
The tour was fantastic. Everything about Wings over Kauai was fantastic. Great communication, check in procedure and instructions for the flight were great.
Nicholas and Captain Matt were outstanding. We had a great time and would definitely use them again.

review_title: Not a good pilot or company
review_text: The pilot was exceeding the  visibility requirements on our tour. I thought this was a safety concern.  I probably wouldn't recommend this company.

review_title: Best plane ride on the island!
review_text: I had such a great time and experience co-piloting! The views are amazing and the pilot is super fun and knowledgeable with the tour, 5 stars around
We ended up going out on a really clear day. It was amazing getting to see the mountains up close. The staff there was extremely hospitable and genuinely nice. I recommend if you're in town!

Reasonably priced. Awesome experience landing on the Ruth Glacier - definitely recommend. Our pilot Clay was super professional, approachable and knowledgeable. Staff at the front desk are also super friendly and helpful. Very professional and safe. Definitely recommend. Thank you 👏

Eric was fantastic event fantastic house we enjoyed everything if I could give him a 10 star it would be a 10 but okay I'll go for the 5 everything was smooth like Smooth Sailing Eric you're the greatest

Soaring over the Alaskan range and seeing Denali up close was one of the most exciting adventures we've ever had.  But then, to land on a glacier...Unbelievable joy!  We were amazed at the view and the experience!

Denali can be socked in, but Talkeetna Air Taxi knows how to manage the weather and they were able to get us above 11,000 feet to see the top of Denali under fabulous blue skies, as well as landing on the glacier for a short while.  Great experience.

Everyone was wonderful especially our pilot. If you are going to spend the money make sure to do the flight with the glacier landing. This was an experience of a lifetime.  Our pilot went above and beyond, no pun intended, She was determined to have us see the summit if at all possible in spite of the clouds rolling in. Well she did it, although it wasn’t a lot or for long, we saw it and what a treat to have extra time on the glacier, maybe because we were the last flight of the day but I say because she is awesome and loves what she does and you can see that she love sharing her time and knowledge.  I highly recommend and I would definitely do it again!!!!
Would recommend to any couple visiting Maui! The experience was spectacular, the views were indescribable and our pilot made the experience super special. Thank you!

Although we never got to meet the former mentioned “Bruce“ our trip with WOK was perfect. We felt absolutely safe ALL the time and Captn Josh really made our trip. While a carefully chosen playlist provided the perfect ambience Josh told us all about the Island and local agriculture. We especially enjoyed the movie location fun facts. The view was just spectacular!Thanks Sherry and Josh!!

Wir haben auf Grund der guten Rückmeldungen den Privatflug in der Cessna gebucht und wurden nicht enttäuscht! Da es recht windig war hatten wir bezüglich des kleinen Flugzeugs doch ein angespanntes Gefühl. Dies war nicht notwendig - Bruce hat uns Sicherheit vermittelt und uns zu Beginn toll abgelenkt, danach haben wir den Flug nur mehr genossen. Vielen Dank, das Erlebnis als Co-Pilotin ist unvergesslich :)

Traveled with my wife and mother-in-law. Not only was the flight and experience awesome, the care and personal service that Steve, Lesley and staff provided was top notch. Steve alleviated all of the concerns my mother-in-law had about climbing in an out of the plane. The flight was smith and the narrative so very interesting.  Words can't describe the beauty of the views. We landed on the lake and enjoyed the quiet there until another plane showed up. boo!  Didn't see much wildlife, only a few goats in the distance. Would recommend without hesitation.
Eric was amazing! He was very informative. This was a last minute decision after I read the reviews we went with him.

Un ottimo modo per conoscere l'isola e fare un'esperienza diversa dal solito. Il punto di vista sulla Na Pali coast è mozzafiato.
La mattina in cui il nostro volo era previsto, le condizioni meteo non erano delle migliori: Lynne al check in e Captain Doug sono stati molto cortesi e informativi, nel cercare di spiegarci le difficoltà e le alternative al programma concordato. 
Al momento del decollo Captain Doug ha intravisto uno spiraglio ed è riuscito infine a mostrarci quasi tutto ciò che si vede normalmente. A bordo c'eravamo solo noi due ed è stato molto piacevole parlare ed ascoltare le sue storie durante tutta la gita. Il volo è stato molto bumpy, come dicono loro, ma ci siamo sempre sentiti in sicurezza.

review_title: Professionals offering a polished, delightful tour
review_text: Everyone told us we had to tour Kaua’i by air during our one week visit: A lot of the beautiful island isn’t accessible by rental car, and the views from up high offer a perspective that really helps you appreciate the tropical paradise found here.  They were right!  But I’ll add a strong suggestion: Go by fixed-wing aircraft using Wings Over Kaua’i.  We had an AMAZING 90-minute flight.  Josh, the lead pilot, is personable, friendly, knowledgeable & professional.  The airplane is a sightseer’s dream: small, cozy, safe, reliable, smooth flying, and every passenger (we had 4) has their own bubble window with an unimpeded view.  (My wife & I shot almost 300 pictures & ended up with 50 that are stunning.)  Everyone associated with the small company is courteous & friendly.  And the cost was a bargain when compared to the value we received & the prices of some helicopter tours.  We booked online for early in our trip, hoping to get the lay of the land before we explored by rental car, but Josh nixed the flight when rain clouds covered too much of the island; he wasn’t going to waste our time or money.  We really appreciated his experienced decision.  Our rescheduled tour at the end of our visit was perfect: We got to see where we HAD been during the week, plus all those hidden gems not visible from roads.  A great time, I assure you, no matter when you fly!  Tip: Schedule your ride early in your visit & early in the day in case the weather isn’t cooperative.  Josh & company will handle the rest.

review_title: Awesome….amazing…would go again in a heartbeat!
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip! What a great experience….Steve and Lesley are great to book with.  We had a beautiful day in Ketchikan and the views were spectacular!  When we climbed aboard they asked for a backseat volunteer….I jumped at it and boy was I glad I did.  I was the only one back there so I was able to take pics from both sides… not that you can’t upfront but I didn’t have to reach over anyone.  I had a lot of room..5”5.  …climbing in and out was pretty easy as well…slow an easy on the steps.  Landing on the lake was….so cool!… the lake was like glass, the pics we have show the reflection of the mtn & clouds on the lake…amazing.  I’m actually still smiling from the experience!   I would highly recommend you book with SeaWind Aviation.

Great views of the island!  Felt safe with the pilot and he made every effort to give everyone a good view.  Couldn't hear some of the dialogue but then my hearing is less than desirable.  Overall, a wonderful trip and well worth it.  The office staff was helpful and courteous.  Thanks.
Eric was very informative and had our best interests at all times. The plane was well kept and he let me fly which was very exciting. He is an instructor too.

Fantastic way to see Kauai.  It was very educational and the pilots knowledge pointing out different parts of the island really helped us the rest of our vacation.  It was absolutely beautiful and being in the air is the only way to really experience Kauai's beauty.

We did the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing. We had a picture perfect morning. Our pilot, Will, excecuted perfect take-offs and landings and the flight was so smooth I hardly felt I was in an airplane until I looked out the windows and saw the incredible mountains, glaciers, cliffs and snow-covered valleys and passes. I was a bit anxious because I can get dizzy at higher altitudes and get motion sickness, but this flight was so smooth I was completely comfortable. I am not talented enough to describe the views and exhilaration of this experience. It is an amazing experience that I cannot recommend highly enough. I want to thank Will (and Anjel, who greeted us upon our departure and also served us the night before at the Wildflower, lol) and all the people at TAT for this amazing experience.

I’ve been living in Alaska for two years and this takes the cake for one of the coolest experiences I’ve had so far. The Talkeetna Air team was incredibly accommodating and professional assisting my cousin who is a paraplegic load the aircraft. Our pilot Tim was so skilled and was a great guide. We had a fantastic time and I would recommend to anyone visiting Alaska.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: We enjoyed our awesome flight with Eric! The cliffs and 5 islands were awesome! It was very scenic and enjoyed flying myself.

Trevor, our pilot, was great, giving us information all along the way.  The company ADDED the glacier landing, saying WE were doing THEM a favor by letting them give it to us.  So kind and professional!  The day was PERFECT and that glacier landing allowed us to play in the snow!  Coming from 106 in Austin, TX, that was a blessing!   We will go back again.  Love love this company!  HIGHLY recommend them!

Overall just a great time in every sense.  It was a windy day on ours which made turbulence more prominent.  Our pilot seemed to have everything handled with confidence and we just enjoyed looking around.  I would go again and I’m glad I did it!

If you had one day in Alaska and had to pick one thing to do, flying with K2 Aviation to Denali National Park for a 3 hour hike (guided by Alaska Alpine Adventures) surrounded by glaciers would fit the bill very nicely. 

Upon early arrival at the K2 Aviation office we were greeted with smiles, filled out a simple form, "weighed in", and relaxed on their sunny deck. The facility and grounds were very nice; clean and well kept. A short time later we boarded a van that took us to the float plane dock a few miles away. The driver was pleasant and made sure we were comfortable. Once there we took a few pictures of the surrounding beauty while passengers deplaned and the aircraft was being topped off with fuel. Our pilot Jeff then introduced himself to us, gave us an easy to understand pre-flight safety briefing and made us feel very safe and welcome. 

We boarded the aircraft and were airborne in short order. Lift off from the water was imperceptible. I know many factors can contribute to the way an airplane performs in flight, weather, aircraft design, pilot's skills, etc. The de Havilland Beaver was solid and smooth flying. What a great comfortable ride from a great Alaskan bush plane classic. The views were nothing short of phenomenal. This is what those Alaskan nature shows dream of capturing on film. Nothing beats the experience of seeing Alaska from the air with your own two eyes. Our richly experienced and confident pilot kept us engaged by pointing out interesting geography and landmarks. The views of colossal glaciers and majestic Denali (Mt. McKinley) were magnificently surreal. Take plenty of memory for your digital cameras. 

We landed on Moraine Lake and touchdown was equally imperceptible. Our hiking guide Elliot greeted us, stored our day bag and gave us trekking poles to begin our three hour hike. He even stuffed our water bottles and our sweaters into his back pack so that our hands could be free to enjoy the hike and take pictures. Elliott was very knowledgeable about the terrain and surrounding beauty of the mountains. It's great to be educated while having fun. His pace matched our abilities and desires. Elliot delivered an enthusiastic and fun adventure.

Upon return to base camp, Elliot set out some chairs for my wife and I and we relaxing at water's edge while he catered crackers, cheese, smoked salmon, and red wine! We had pleasant conversations amid one of the most beautiful and secluded sub-arctic locations known to mankind. We were a bit saddened to leave so soon as the sound of Jeff's plane returned to fly us back to Talkeetna. The flight back was just as breathtaking. Once again we saw incredible glacier features, moose, and a some of the same sights as before but from a different angle...equally impressive.

A huge thanks to all involved in making our tour, safe, enjoyable, and the unforgettable highlight of our summer!

AK residents: get out and enjoy our state with K2 Aviation, (ask for pilot Jeff), and Alaska Alpine Adventures...don't let the tourists have all the fun!

Experience of a lifetime!  It was a beautiful day, and an absolute delight to see a glacier from the sky. The views were spectacular, and landing on the lake was exceptional. We had so much fun going out on the pontoons, taking pictures and enjoying the majesty of the peaceful lake.
What made the trip an extra bonus was our pilot, Chuck! His narration of the sights was very helpful. He added some of his favorite music in between, with pertinent words to the experience. His love of his job & of flying, his awe of the scenery and respect for creation were all infectious.  I love to be with someone who enjoys his life so much. Thank you, Chuck!!
Very friendly. Due to weather, could not do the originally scheduled tour around Mt. Denali. They were very helpful in finding an alternate with minimal co-pay. Just awesome experience!

This was a certain highlight of the time we spent in Kauai.  The hour went so quickly because every view was entertaining and enjoyable.  This is a must-do in the safety and security of a fixed wing plane.  Wow!  Can we do it again?

John C made our 30th feel as special as the magnificent wonder of the world we were going to visit 

Obviously a great pilot, it’s the softer skills of charm, humor and simply caring that made us feel compelled to right this review

If we came back we would insist on having John but the highest praise I can give is that if one of our daughters brought him home we would welcome into our home
Thanks to John , Gail and team

Spencer took us up for our flight. He was very personable and knowledgeable about the area telling us all kinds of neat facts about the sights. He seemed like a great pilot and a great guy and if we are ever in the area again will be sure to request him so we can get that downtown tour.

It was great plane ride!
We were going for a helicopter ride and decided last minute to switch up to a plane ride and wow 
Good thing we did!
It was the greatest experience we could have done in Maui!
Everytbing was so great I will be doing it again in the future!

review_title: Parfait.Je suis tombé sur un pilote français aux commentaires très complets qui a fait un tour plus grand que prévu.mon
review_text: Mon 5ème vol sur San Francisco en 25 ans.Le meilleur.Demander le pilote français pour bien profiter des commentaires.

review_title: Flying with K2 to view Denali
review_text: Myself and wife, flew with K2 to see Denali, great professional trip.  Picked up at our hotel, easy interview and sign in.  Short wait to get in the air.  Pilot was very knowledgeable and answered our questions before asked and encouraged questions.  Fly out of his way to make sure we all had photo ops and saw all explaining what we were seeing.  One our best experiences.  Highly recommended.

Our flight was canceled twice due to weather. I am glad that the pilot was safety, conscious, and did not want to take any chances but this was obviously very disappointing. My main complaint was the way this was handled and how disorganized the operation seemed. First of all, they did not notify us of the cancellation until we arrived on site. That meant that we had to pay for a taxi ride from the cruise terminal to the airport and back, which was $20 each way. And then there was a significant delay in getting our refund. I had to call them several times. My refund didn’t actually appear on my statement until one month after the cancellation. They were very nice on the phone, but it seemed like they were not well organized.

Pilot was very friendly and flight was awesome! This was a gift for my son's 20th Birthday and my son said it was the best time ever ..He loved every minute and could not stop smiling from ear to ear... my son got to sit in front and fly co pilot ..it was AWESOME!!
Absolutely amazing! An experience of a life time, will definitely recommend as an activity to do whilst on holiday

What a fantastic tour of the glaciers, and Mt. McKinley was in its awesome majesty.  It was a  perfectly clear and beautiful day.  David, our pilot, is an excellent tour guide with so much information about the mountains and glaciers, and I believe he was having as much fun as we were seeing the mountains and glaciers on such a clear day!  Walking on the glacier was an experience to behold.  It definitely was a highlight of our trip!  I heartily recommend the glacier air experience!!!  The staff is very friendly and accommodating!
Absolutely wonderful experience!!! Worth every penny!! Pilot was friendly, safe, efficient, concerned with our safety and enjoyment; don't know how it could have been better!!
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: Grand Denali Glacier Tour with Glacier Landing
review_text: The tour was fantastic. LeAnn was our pilot and she was amazing.  The highlight of our trip. Will definitely book another flight on our next trip.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: The view going over the crater is nothing short of spectacular. Takes a bit to get up to 10K feet but so worth the time. Our pilot, Steve, is excellent. Will book him for our next trip to see the cliffs of molakai!!
Great flight- good information from our pilot - very smooth enjoyable flight over Grand Canyon. Everyone should do this- spectacular .  Wonderful service , nice facility
This plane tour is a must. You will see the mountains from another perspective and the pilot is amazing as well. I LOVE everything about it highly recommended to do it. 100% worth it

I was surprised and very pleased to land on a glacier.  It was late October; a fresh snow blanked the terrain the night before the flight.   On the return flight, I overheard our seasoned pilot express the trip saying, "lots of action", I completely agreed.  The sun illuminated freshly covered granite mountain peaks, after the snow fall with a few low-lying clouds.  Plus seeing a high overview of glacier details. Just fantastic!

My mother, husband, and my 13 year old went on our tour with Seawind Aviation.  Leslie was great meeting us near the Ketchikan vistor center. She brought us to where the plane was and we boarded.  We were all very excited to experience take off on the water and landing on the water.  The flight was incredible seeing the beautiful mountains at Misty Fyords.  Steve was our pilot and on the way back he swung around so we could see a bear from the air.  Over all we had a great experience and a great memory to share.  IT is a little expensive for a  large family but I think it is worth it if you can afford it.
This trip was amazing! Our first small plane tour. We saw the most beautiful landscape that you could only see from the sky. We highly recommend this tour! Laura was an excellent host & pilot!

We did the Denali flyer with Glacier landing trip today. What a 5-star trip it was. Everything from booking the trip, check in, the flight, the experience and the glacier landing was top notch. The Kahiltna Glacier is amazingly 44 miles long and we flew over it for a long time and then landed on the Pika glacier. 
I will say again, everything was top notch and I will do it again, in a heart beat. Everyone was very professional and it is totally worth the money, considering how high we flew and what all we saw. I would recommend the trip as a must for anyone visiting Alaska.

This is a great alternative to helicopter tours, especially if one is a larger person, as I am, as the helicopter tours want to charge you for an extra seat if one is over 220 to 240 pounds. 

I had done a helicopter tour of the island many years ago when I was either a but thinner or they didn't have the requirements to buy the extra seat ( probably a little from column A and a little from column B but anyway I digress). Having done both the helicopter and the plane around the island, you are not really missing out by taking the plane. In fact, the plane allows you to see the majesty of the canyon and Pali coast more as sometimes the helicopters just get too close to see it all at once and take in the majesty of it all.

Bruce and the team are just so friendly and made the whole process and trip just so enjoyable. 

I would recommend this tour to anyone. An added bonus is that it is half the price of a helicopter.

Very pleased with trip. Pilot Eric very good tour guide. I was seated in the co-pilot's seat. Eric even took pictures for me with my phone. My only complaint was that when Eric turned his head to the left I couldn't hear him. It was like the head phones were cutting out.

We took the 50 min ride through the canyon and it was a fantastic experience. Our pilot was very experienced, added great information and we felt very safe at any stage. If you go to the south rim, you've got to treat yourself to that helicopter tour...

review_title: Extreme experience at low price, Kauai from the sky
review_text: There are many places in Kauai where ordinal transportation can not reach. See from the sky is one of the good way.

What an awesome joy it was for us to fly with Jason. I have never ridden in that small of a plane and was not sure of what to expect. I was amazed at how smooth and comfortable a ride it was. I noticed with Jason, besides his experience of the terrain that safety was an up-most priority of his. The views of Denali and Mount McKinley were spectacular! I can't use enough words or had taken enough pictures  to describe what we saw in the air. I never thought that this plane ride would be on the top of my list of things that I have experienced.

Io e la mia compagna abbiamo avuto la fortuna di partecipare ad un tour aereo di Kauai in una giornata nitida e senza nuvole. Impressionanti i colori contrastanti del mare, delle montagne e del canyon dall'alto. L'isola è davvero un paradiso naturale. Il pilota Eric è stato eccezionale, premuroso nei nostri confronti, disponibilissimo a raccontare tutto ciò che vedevamo e a rispondere ai nostri quesiti. Consiglierei il tour a chiunque perchè merita davvero apprezzare l'isola dal cielo.
Felt like a roller coaster at times but it was do to high winds but Stephen assured us it was normal. Great flight! Keep it up

I'm the guy trying to go everywhere once. Today was to fly over the volcano for my lady's birthday.  Concerned we would miss it , we pulled up a few minutes early. Eric promptly greeted us and removed the fear we maybe in the wrong place. From beginning to end he was so nice to us, sharing a dream together! My daughter had the best day ever and as far as Jamie and I, it couldn't be any better. It was as spending a day with an old friend. Had an amazing experience! If I choose a repeat vacation,  it would be flying with Eric.  Simply a wonderful day and I know if you go, your going to LOVE IT. WAYNE WILLIAMS

My Partner and I took the Stump Town at 9pm.  We met our pilot Daniel at the check in desk.  He is so friendly and certainly helped calm our nerves.  Portland is such a beautiful city at night.  Daniel is a great pilot, our flight was smooth including the landing.  I will be booking a flight with ENVI for July 4th next year.

The pilots are great and the views from your Beaver aircraft are beautiful!  The commentary is just enough to let you witness nature and the pilots are highly successful navigating the difficult weather of the Ketchikan area.  You can't go wrong and if you worry about air sickness, forget about it.  The view will cure anyone of it!

We celebrated my husband’s birthday with Maui Plane Tours. Eric was great! He explained everything and the process was so smooth. We saw all five islands and took amazing photos. It was an incredible experience and we will remember it forever.

review_title: An awesome tour of Kauai from the air!
review_text: Our pilot, Kevin, is an outstanding, seasoned pilot and a fantastic tour guide for Kauai.  He demonstrated an excellent knowledge of Kauai and it's history, and constantly showed concern for the passengers' comfort and safety.  I would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii - and Kevin for an introduction to all that Kauai has to offer.  I recommend the flight early in your stay on Kauai.

review_title: scenic flight Misty Fjords Ketchikan Alaska
review_text: The most scenic flight we ever did. Met een DeHavilland Beaver floatplane meevliegen door de fantastische Misty Fjords met zeer interessante uitleg door de piloot en af en toe een mooi begeleidend muziekfragment door je koptelefoon, samengevat: FABULOUS !
This was an amazing activity to finish up our Alaska vacation! The views were incredible, the pilot was a great guide, and the glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience.

We were blessed with 70 degree weather and blue skies when we decided to do the glacier flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  All I can say is WOW !  Do not miss because 
this is a once in life time experience.  Again, we were blessed with crazy great weather.
4 of us in Cessna 185 and we landed at glacier at base of Denali.  Our pilot was one of the owner's Paul.  So cool and what pictures . They will pick you up in downtown Talkeetna and bring you back.

From booking to landing everything was great.  Easy to book online.  Very welcoming when we arrived.  The flight was smooth and beautiful.  Bruce answered all our questions via Bose headphones.  It was a great way to see the island.  Highly recommended!!

review_title: Amazing experience of Denali and Ruth Glacier
review_text:
My boyfriend and I took the $350 Base Camp Tour with Glacier Landing flightseeing trip and it was worth every cent. We were very lucky to have clear weather and were in a plane with 10 passengers. We flew up to Denali and went around about 270 degrees and back, including over the Denali climbing base camp, which was really interesting. The pilot made sure to go back and forth so that everyone could take pictures, no matter what side of the plane they were on. We landed on Ruth Glacier and stayed for about 20 minutes, but couldn't go very far from the plane unfortunately. In the future, I would look into doing a longer trip with some trekking around the glacier. Nevertheless, it was beautiful and awe-inspiring. The scale of the mountains and glaciers is just unbelievable. 

The only complaint I would have is about the smell of diesel in the plane. It wasn't overwhelming, but if you're sensitive to it, you wouldn't enjoy it very much.

Overall, it was an amazing trip that I would recommend to anyone. We didn't go up to Denali NP for the bus trip, so this was a great way to see it anyway. If you're staying in Talkeetna, or are active US military, ask about their discounts. We ended up saving over $100 total off the $700 bill.
Front desk staff was awesome. Pilot Desi was really good. She took her time in welcoming us. She is the best. She is the best tour guide with a pilot cap.

Eric was just awsome,from the booking until the amazing flight.
It was secure, he gave us explanation about maiu and what we were seeing.
Amaizing expirience, really worth it!!
We recomend every one, it will change all your trip.
Mahalo!!

Thank you for this amazing tour - it was one of the most beautiful experiences in my life! In German:
It was an unbelievably great experience, an incomparably beautiful tour that I would definitely recommend and would happily repeat.

We took a flightseeing tour of Mt. McKinley/Denali with Talkeetna Air on our trip to Alaska two weeks ago.  It was a once in a lifetime experience that we can't stop talking about.  There are a few different planes depending on the number of people going, but we were in the Otter.  The pilot made us feel very calm and relaxed, and he kept us updated through the whole flight on what we were seeing and the history of the mountain through headsets we were all wearing.  I'm not one for small planes, but this was comfortable and relaxing.  A huge highlight was the stop on a glacier -- the beauty is breathtaking.  We couldn't have asked for a better experience starting with the staff at check-in until the moment we left.  Thank you Talkeetna Air for one of the most memorable events in our lives!

review_title: Excellent flight, could not land due to conditions.
review_text: We had a wonderful flight around the beautiful mountain, day was excellent and so was the time we spent during the flight.  Missed being able to land but certainly out of anyone's control, they were taking care of safety.  Thank you so much
Amazing experience! A must do for your trip to Maui. This is the only way to see the island. Had a blast!!

Good communication via phone.  $270 bought us a plane ride + glacier landing.  The airport was super busy on a beautiful day.  They have a deck out back where you can watch all the planes.  They gave us sunglasses and boots for the glacier.  Pilot (tom?) was excellent, and gave a great tour as he flew.  Plane ride was smooth.  The return had a few bumps, I did have mild nausea in the back, which I'm prone to.  Sitting in front was better and very cool.  

DO NOT EAT THE GLACIER SNOW.  They always land there (3 planes were on the glacier while we were there).  I'm sure some kids/people must have urinated there before.  It's always cold, so waste is not going anywhere.  Just Sayin'

Overall, decide first if you think it's worth so much money for such a short experience.  Before going, I was very ambivalent about the value.  In retrospect, there is no other way to see the mountains/Denali so closely.  

The safety issue is also important to me.  I do *think* they are very conservative, because they won't sell the longer tours with marginal weather.  The pilot had many years experience.

Talkeetna is a cool place.

This was the most amazing experience.  We had a picture perfect day.  Our pilot was great and the flight was wonderful.  Landing on Ruth Glacier was a once in a lifetime experience.  We used a coupon from the Northern Lights coupon book.  Buy 3 get one free.

From the initial contact and reservation through every detail of the preflight briefing and flight, the entire Maverick team was professional and friendly. My initial contact was via chat, where the operator suggested the type of flight that would best meet our needs and price. No pressure, totally knowledgeable and courteous from start to finish.

Their facility at the Grand Canyon Airport is recently renovated and spotless. The staff there is friendly and efficient. The flight was perfect, with great narration and the helicopter is designed so that everyone has a great view. The interior of the helicopter is heated and air conditioned, and each person has a comfortable headset, so the narration and conversation is clear.

Don't bother with lesser providers - this is the company to book with, you won't be sorry.

Flight 11 July 2015 - Didn't tell my 3 kids (ages 28, 22 and 18) we were going on this until we got to the airport and were checking in.  I highly recommend the element of surprise for this age group.   Had an absolutely fantastic trip with Josh who not only new how to fly a plane but engaged us all in exacting facts about trees, waterfalls, swimming bays and movie locations.  My kids absolutely loved seeing movie spots from Jurassic World.   

We were very disappointed about two days later when we got a call stating that all the video feed from the inside Go-Pros had been lost but I realized I had not even known that we would have the option of this so we compromised and we moved on.  

Tonight we watched out edited version of Go-Pros from the external cameras combined with an audio soundtrack and captions and while it would have been nice to have us in it, it is a very memorable caption of our flight and we are very delighted with how it all worked out.

Things happen, so be it.   The true test is how a company responds.   Wings Over Kauai exceeded customer service in this area and took our wonderful memories, captured them, and provided us with a video that will always reminded us of what a great flight it was because of the video.
Hearing the history behind the land! It was really amazing— loved it!! I would recommend to everyone it was a lot of fun and a unique experience.

This tour was the favorite of all the things we enjoyed during our vacation to the islands. Bruce and staff were friendly and welcoming, quickly making us feel at ease. Our pilot Josh, previously a commercial airlines pilot, was interesting and informative as he pointed out highlights of the tour. The flight was smooth and comfortable and afforded us an excellent overview of Kauai. Although there were low clouds and light rain at times, the views were still spectacular.  The time just flew by ( no oun intended), and we hated to see it come to an end! From start to finish, this was a fabulous experience. Highly recommend!!!!!
Absolutely amazing. My wife says she couldn’t stop smiling. This makes no sense to do a hundred characters

Seeing the highlights of Arches, Canyonlands, and Moab from the air was an incredible experience. Our pilot, Dave, was professional, kind, very knowledgeable about geology and the area's history, and he was sensitive to our needs and comfort. HIGHLY recommended way to see one of the most beautiful places on earth. In order to appreciate the geologic wonders of southeast Utah, a bird's eye view is where it's at. Thanks Dave, for giving us an experience of a lifetime!

The plane was really old, the engine wasn't starting the first time, there was holes in the seats, there was trouble closing the doors, and it was overall very uncomfortable ride and the view wasn't good either. The model of this plane was 1973 with a very bad engine, I'm surprised how this plane is allowed to fly in this plane. The plane had rust inside and out, we are just happy to land safely on the ground.Waste of money and I don't recommend this to anyone!

review_title: The most amazing excursion!!!It made our trip
review_text: This is a family owned business and the care they show to their customers is unsurpassed. Josh was very informative and personalized the trip to the needs of all of us on the plane. This was a smooth ride like riding in a car not at all choppy and jerky which you may get on a helicopter. Josh's narrative was very interesting and he mad sure that we got plenty of "money" shots of the beautiful sights around the island. We were doing an inter-island cruise of Big Island, Honolulu, Maui,and Kauai and they picked us up at the ABC store by the ship and brought us back to the same ABC store before the ship left in plenty of time.  This was our favorite excursion by far. This is a MUST DO if you are on Kauai and it is half the price of a helicopter ride. They video tape your whole ride for you and you can buy it and have it sent to you. Just a tip confirm with them the day you are to be  picked up especially if you are on a cruise ship. They will take care of you!

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: We took the early p.m. flight.  Very easy access at the airport.  Big Kahuna flight takes you on hour-long clockwise tour of island.  Sit upfront and on the right side of plane.  Other seats do not have as good views.  Headphones allow pilot to give information, and you have microphone to ask the pilot questions.  There is no background music, and you will hear other ground to plane and plane to plane chatter on your headphones.  Of course, the plane does not hover or land anywhere like some helicopter trips, but here is the payback--it costs $100 less per person than the helicopters.  The weather was good for our flight, which made things more enjoyable.  Very good, safe operation.

Wir sind mit der Gesellschaft von Ketchikan nach Neets Bay mit dem Wasserflugzeug geflogen. Jeder Passagier hatte einen Fensterplatz.
Der Flug war ruhig und die Aussicht vom Flieger auf die unter einem liegenden Wälder und Seen grandios.

The best part of our whole trip! Must get Matt as your pilot. He was an amazing pilot with an amazing personality. The ride was smooth and he was full of knowledge. Took us to beautiful places. I was with my 76 yr old dad and 8 yr old daughter. They had the best time. My 8 yr old keeps talking about her experience and how she wants to do it again. I feel the same way!!
Wonderful scenery, great instruction and the kids loved every minute. I highly encourage anyone to take a flight with Eric while visiting Maui!!!
Denali glacier landing from talkeetna was fantastic! Definitely a must do if you find yourself in the adorable Talkeetna tourist town or if you're looking for adventure!

review_title: Excellent flight with a focus on safety
review_text: Not to be missed. This is the best way to see Denali. You can really appreciate the majesty of the mountain range and Denali from the air.

review_title: The best view of Denali with the best pilot.
review_text: The pilot, Leanne. She is phenomenal. Looking at her, all 90 lbs soaking wet, you won't believe she is a pilot. She made the flight an unforgetable experience. I would do it again in a heart beat.

review_title: Add this to the Bucket List!
review_text: If you want to see Denali up close and personal this is a must do. Well worth the money we had awesome weather and visibility was close to perfect. Bucket List for sure.

review_title: You only have to read my comments
review_text:
To be fair, I want to say upfront that this review focuses not only on the provider but also on Trip Advisor (based on the comments of the owner/vendor that Trip Advisor is horrible to dealt with on his end) . Sadly I did not get to revisit a great experience. I took this tour 10 years ago with my late wife and it was truly wonderful. Please note at that time I weighed in excess of 300 pounds. My late wife 175 pounds. We had no issue at the time because our combined average weight met the vendors parameters. Now to 2022.  I booked this latest tour 20 days before our arrival, entered all of the pertinent information, including body weight,  on the Trip Advisor booking page and paid my $368, expecting to again have a wonderful experience. 25 hours before our appointed excursion I receive an email from the Vendor thru the Trip Advisor platform that they are not able to accommodate us based on my weight being in excess of 300 pounds, the maximum PER SEAT, but if I wanted to buy an additional  seat on the next day....... I stated that my wife weighs 170 so our combined weight of 490 for two seats equated to 245 pounds per seat. Deaf Ears. OK I get it, please refund my booking. "NO, we are not able to refund your booking and it is Trip Advisors fault". OK, You, Air Venture, are the entity denying my booking, yet you cannot refund my money even though YOU are the entity who is refusing to provide the contracted service. "It is Trip Advisor's fault". OK I entered my correct weight on the Trip Advisor site when I  booked. Do YOU not communicate your parameters to Trip Advisor? "It is Trip Advisors fault". OK, Isn't Trip Advisor your Agent, therefore an extension of Air Ventures? "It is Trip Advisors fault". OK, you do realize Air Ventures that I will be leaving a negative review on the said "Trip Advisor" based on this interaction? "DON'T THREATEN ME" and hung up. So, if you decide to book a trip with Air Ventures, I suggest you stay away from Trip Advisor or any other third party booking site as the owner of Air Venture will not work with you if there is an issue, even if it is his fault. 

You will note that this is the only truly negative review I have ever left on Trip Advisor. God Bless Air Ventures. I hope you survive in business with your superb customer service.

This was the perfect way to see Kauai.  We did this our second day and it gave us a great overview of the island.  The scenery was spectacular and we got great pictures.   I would recommend this for any visitor to the island.  

The airplane is small so you need to be fit enough to climb in and get to your seat.  It is not for the person who is a "white knuckle" flyer.  There is turbulence.

review_title: Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure - Excellent!
review_text: Professional, friendly, and accommodating. We recently had the pleasure of taking Westwind Air Service’s Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure Tour. We were extremely impressed with the entire operation and all involved were exceedingly helpful from the moment we inquired about taking this tour, until we returned from seeing the West Rim of the Grand Canyon. The tour itself was a great experience with excellent pilots and a tour that was delivered as promised.  The views on the flight to and from the Grand Canyon were spectacular and were accompanied by great audio in both directions that discussed the history and geography of the area. The Skywalk was a unique experience and the helicopter ride to the Colorado was amazing. A nice boat ride on the Colorado River completed the trip. Based upon our experience, I would highly recommend using Westwind Air Service on any of their offered tours.

Bruce and Wings Over Kauai is Exceptional! For our honeymooon, I decided to book Wings Over Kauai with the cruise add on with Blue Dolphin. We scheduled it for the first full day of our visit as recommended on the site. I called to reserve and Bruce was extremely helpful in answering all my questions regarding what to expect, the difference between helicopter and airplane and he answered questions about the cruise.  When we arrived for the ride, we were greeted by his daughter and she took us to get weighed (don't worry she won't tell you what it says unless you want to know) then gave the women a  kukui lei and a flower for behind the ear.  Then she went over the sites we would be seeing on a map of Kauai and went over the safety information.  After, we were greeted by our pilot and owner, Bruce.  He got a picture of us in front of the plane, got us strapped in and we started pre-check.  Bruce was very energetic and engaging by involving us in the pre-check and all the pre-flight items.  Once we were off, the views were spectacular! The windows were large and I got over 600 beautiful aerial and close up pictures. I didn't have any issues with glare (I was worried) and he even paused a little longer to get shots if asked via the headset.  Upon landing, he informed us that he has a compiled list of his favorite things to do on Kauai.  This list included hidden spots to visit, parks, restaurants and more.   In addition, as we de-boarded the plane, his daughter greeted us with the list of Bruce's Favorites and our own copy of a DVD of a flight (not ours, but another one his son made), but our picture was on the front! How cool is that?!?!  

I highly recommend this company, as they truly show Mahalo to everyone. They will go above and beyond to make your visit memorable. You will not regret anything, but only be earning to go again.

Besides the birth of my sons,  viewing 7 bears eating salmon at Traitors Cove was the best experience in my lifetime! It was so magical I even hugged the owner, Steve, who was our pilot after our trip. I simply couldn’t help myself!  Our very experienced and quite entertaining guide, Drew, was excellent! The walk through the Lord of the Rings land to get to the bears is beyond description. This experience is worth every cent including tipping Drew more than we have ever have before on any excursion. Enjoy!

We decided to take this tour after the rain during the early part of our vacation likely made it hard to hike the Na Pali coast. We looked at how pricey the helicopters were and settled on this option - but we soon found out that we didn't settle at all! We definitely feel like we got an amazing experience for much less than the helicopter tours.
The experience was great, check in was smooth, and we took our tour on the 2 person Cessna. You are involved in the flight from the beginning and they definitely do a good job of welcoming you - giving you flowers and leis and then taking good pictures of you with your plane. The pilot was great and calmed my nerves.
The views are amazing - we must have seen over a dozen waterfalls on our flight. It was so beautiful we can't even describe in this review - you have to see for yourself. You definitely get a more panoramic view of the island and a more personal experience doing this flight over the helicopter tours. We highly highly recommend it!
This is one of the best experiences Kauai has to offer.  Great staff and wonderful views!!!  Beats helicopter rides all the way!!!
Wonderful tour of the island and outstanding pilot!  We'd love to do this again.  Pilot is very knowledgeable and showed us a great tour!

review_title: Nice guys and a great tour
review_text: Everyone was so welcoming and patient. Our pilot was upbeat and knowledgeable. We were so satisfied we left a generous tip. It wasn't cheap but it was worth the price.

Wonderful . I love it so much!!! It was an amazing journey to see the Maui over the clouds. The sunset was breathtaking!!! The flight was pretty smooth. Love Laura !!! She is an amazing guide and pilot!!! Definitely, book it when you are Maui!!! 💓💕❣️💖❤️💗❣️💓😘🥰🤩💖💞💓💕❣️

review_title: Breathtaking experience with an awesome pilot
review_text: This was our first Alaska trip and the last adventure we had booked at the last minute.  What an experience! Nothing even comes close. Talkeetna Air Taxi was the most professional company. Everything was easy to do from the simple website, to the clear instructions on what to bring and, most importantly, the focus on safety. We did the Southside explorer with Glacier landing. The best choice ever as the North side was all smoked out and we were told you could maybe view the top of the mountain at some angle.  Our pilot, Melissa was so much fun and she went into enormous details about each mountain and the glacier and a lot of fun facts. She even allowed my son to sit with her next to the pilot's seat. He was simply blown away by the experience. The landing, which I was a little wary of, was smooth as butter. And what a view when you get out. The mighty Denali just right there in front of you looking regal glistening in the sun. We got a lot of time hanging around the glacial amphitheater admiring the pools of blue water and even tried to build a snowman. This is the best company you can choose for the Denali view and landing. The return was perfect too and everything was done so well.

This was a wonderful flight over the park and a sunny, clear view of the mountain! We were so lucky since our first flight six years ago was fogged out and no view at all! The pilot was knowledgeable and able to point out the interesting areas, including people who were climbing to the summit. We would do this flight again!

We used Talkeetna Air Taxi for a Grand Denali Tour.  We arrived and the staff was great to make us feel welcome and comfortable.  A camera and sunglasses are a must.  Our pilot Andy did a wonderful job making sure that all sides of the plane got to see the views and explained things as we flew.  We got to see a rarity - an avalanche.  I couldn’t take pictures fast enough.  Andy allowed us to enjoy the beauty of the mountains, but provided a climbers perspective as well.  A bucket list trip!  So very glad we did it!

review_title: Awesome flying get and Glacier landing
review_text: I booked this months in advance and they did a great job holding our reservation. K2 is quite a large operation in Talkeetna, but the staff treats you well. Our pilot, Chris, was very personable. He came from a family of Alaskan pilots. My wife got to sit in the copilot seat. If they ask who wants to sit there, raise your hand quickly. Flying between peaks was awesome. Landing in the snow in July, wow. It’s pricy...but probably our best experience in our first two weeks in Alaska. And tip your pilot! Don’t be like the majority of passengers on our flight and just shake his hand.

One of the truly memorable experiences of my life. Up there with snorkelling on the Great Barrier Reef and safari in South Africa. The moment the pilot said “We are currently at about 1,000 feet and now it’s 4,000 feet” as we went over the edge of the canyon will never leave me.

I had never flown in a helicopter before and was slightly apprehensive but I needn’t have worried. Everybody at Maverick was excellent and the pilot was very through about the safety procedures. He was also very informative about what we were seeing and how the canyon had developed over the eons. From the moment we took off to the second we landed was enjoyable.

You think you can see quite a lot from the edge of the canyon but it’s as nothing compared to what you see from the helicopter. We hope to visit the canyon again sometime and if we do we’ll be booking another flight with Maverick.

a once in a lifetime experience!!!
waaaaaauwwwwww!!!!
i would recommend this to everyone who wants to see Denali up close!!!
go go go !!!!

Had a great flight with Ethan. Very sceanic. Beautiful views of the waterfalls. Made me appreciate how hard the drive to Hana would have been. Landing was fun. Awesome photos in the rainforest with a huge Monkeypod tree.

What a wonderful experience!! This is the way you want to see Maui! Eric was great and very knowledgeable! This is a must do excursion! No other adventure has compared to this during our stay to this beautiful island.

High marks for this tour. The mountain was open ( no clouds ) we booked on the spot and where in the air within a half hour.  One of the best tours we went on. The price was 60% YES 60% lower than a air tour we booked through our cruise line. Call direct and book this one ,or stop by there booth in " Down town" Talkeetna.

The ride and airplane were good. The taller person should sit on the outside of the traveled route so that he or she can see despite what the pilot says. My wife was on the outside and couldn't see much. A suitable cushion for short people would be a good idea. The voice activated microphones were very noisy because of the wind and we could not here much of the pilot commentary. A press to talk type might be better.

Our family of 6, including my 81 yo father-in-law and his wife all did the Denali flight with glacier landing on our recent 10 day trip to Alaska.  It was the highlight of our trip. Really beautiful views, and our pilot (who has been doing this flight/landing several times a day for 14 years!) was top notch.  We were never nervous.  Worth every penny!
As suggested in other reviews, we scheduled an early flight.  When we arrived we were told we could fly, but the landing area on the mountain was too foggy for landing and that portion of our cost would be refunded.  We were offered the chance to reschedule for the afternoon, which we took.  By then the landing site was clear so we got to land!  As we were preparing to take off from the glacier, which was really cool, the fog and snow started to return.  A real window of opportunity and luck!
Steve was amazing!!! We loved the plane ride and appreciated all of the knowledge filled tidbits about the islands!
My husband and I had the most amazing experience! I’m pregnant and it was the most smooth, safe, gorgeous ride!

We chose not to do the West Rim direct from Las Vegas, but an extended tour with Maverick.  We went by bus to an out of town "executive" airport and went on a Maverick turbprop (19 seats) for about an hour to their heliport near the South Rim.  That was special - boarding cards with just your first name on, an invite to,see the cockpit since no turbulence and even got a photo off the flight dexk.  At the heliport we got in a helicopter, three passengers in front row and four in the back, and went at low level over the scrub / trees,, suddenly  being a mile up as we went over the edge.  We flew to the North Rim and a bit of a tour round.  Great youg pilot who put Jimi Hendrix in the headphones - just perfect.
After, we had a trolley tour to the rim and had a relaxing view into the "hole".  Not a lot of time there and we went back to the plane for the return to Vegas.  What we bought in the shop was waiting on our seats..

It's a must see if you're in San Fran, especially if it's your first time in the City. I've been here many times and it's still awe-inspiring from the air. We had a great pilot, and the booking process was easy with Ana. Don't miss out!
Amazing time. Great views. We saw great sea cliffs and they were great. Flew in a cessna 172 and it flew well.

In a place where weather can change in an instant and weather reports aren't always accurate you want a pilot that is a confirmed Coward.   I grew up In Southeast Alaska and learned at an early age that if the pilot doesn't want to go I do t want to go either.  These are consummate professionals who exercise superior judgement in taking people to see some of the most remote and rugged scenery in the world.

We had a great time sightseeing with Jason. He is a super competent pilot which made us all feel at ease. 
Unfortunately, we didn’t see any wildlife but that was beyond anyone’s control. Next time.
We had an awesome time!  Full view of Denali!  Riley, our pilot did an amazing job.  We had a perfect landing on Ruth Glacier.  Thank you, K2 Aviation!  Highly recommend the trip with the landing.

Glacier landing, Denali up close and personal, what more can one ask of a flight service. Incredible views, amazing views, fantastic views. Get the idea!  Breathtaking and speechless are just two adjectives to describe the flight.

My wife and I booked the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing for August 29.
  
K2 arranged pick-up and drop off service for us at the Talkeetna Lodge.  The transfers were completed smoothly.   We were informed that since Alaska experienced one of the warmest summers on records the snow on Denali was too soft to conduct the glacier landing.   I had been following the latest Tripadvisor reviews and anticipated this situation, disappointing, but totally understandable.  Since the tour was prepaid our credit card was reimbursed in a timely manner.

The plane has a capacity of 10 or 11 passengers and we had seven clients on this trip.   You are provided with headphones which permit the pilot to narrate information during the flight.   The headphones also contained a microphone which allows you to ask questions during the experience.

Each customers has a window seat which provides excellent views and an opportunity for unobstructed photography.  Frequently the pilot would maneuver the plane so the passengers on the right side would have a view of a glacier/mountain/point of interest and then adjust the route so the passengers on the left side would have a similar view.

Due to the Swan Lake fire the visibility directly after take-off was less than ideal.   The pilot indicated this would clear up as we gained altitude and approached the mountain range.   He was 100% correct as visibility was excellent as we approached Denali.

The day before we were fortunate to observe  Denali as we exited the park.   K2 provided an entirely different visual experience.  The excursion is definitely on the expensive side, but since this was likely our one and only trip to Alaska it was totally worth it.  

The Denali Experience is the basic of the three tours that K2 offers, for us the length of time in the air was satisfactory.

This was an amazing experience.  Very close to port ( on cruise).  Took Uber 

The pilot was Shaden and he was a host and gave us a fabulous commentary when on plane.

I was on a knee walker and it was no issue for me to get on and off the plane. They brought the walker back to plane on return.

Clean facilities.  

And the price was very competitive!
